Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was going outside to play. She saw something moving near the grass and she bent down to have a closer look.

It was a frog!

The little girl pointed at the frog and said, "Look, a frog!" The frog didn't move. It felt cold.

The little girl was brave. She slowly put her hand near the frog and said, "It's okay little frog." But the frog still didn't move.

The little girl thought for a moment and then she smiled. She said, "I know! I'm going to get you something warm. I'll be right back!"

The little girl went inside and came back with a warm blanket. She gently wrapped the frog in the blanket and soon the frog felt warm and cozy.

The little girl smiled. She said, "There you go little frog. Now you'll be nice and warm."

The frog looked up at the little girl and slowly hopped away.

The little girl smiled and waved goodbye to the frog. She knew the frog was safe and warm.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who loved to run. He was very fast and won every race he entered. People said he was gifted because he was so good at running. One day, he went to a store and saw a toy car he really wanted. His mom said he couldn't get it, but the boy didn't give up. He saved his money and finally had enough to buy the car. He was so happy, he ran all the way home. But when he got there, he realized he didn't really like the car after all. So, he returned it to the store and got his money back.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toys. He had a favorite old teddy bear that he always carried with him. One day, Timmy's friend Jimmy came over to play. Jimmy saw the old teddy bear and said, "That toy is not cool. I don't like it."

Timmy felt sad and said, "I disagree. My teddy bear is very special to me. It has a lot of value because it was a gift from my grandma."

Jimmy thought about it and said, "You're right. I'm sorry for saying that. Maybe I can play with your teddy bear too."

Timmy smiled and said, "That's okay. We can share it." They played together happily with the old teddy bear and had a lot of fun. From then on, Jimmy understood the value of old toys and never disagreed with Timmy again.

Once upon a time, there was a group of animal friends. They loved to play together and have fun. One day, they decided to go on an adventure in the forest. 

As they walked, they came across a little bird who was lost. The group of friends felt sad for the bird and decided to help him find his way home. They searched and searched until they found the bird's nest. 

The bird was so happy and grateful that he laughed and sang a beautiful song for his new friends. The group of friends felt proud and happy that they could help the little bird. 

From that day on, the little bird became a loyal friend to the group. They all learned that helping others can bring joy and happiness to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they decided to measure how tall they were. Lily was the shortest of all her friends, but that didn't make her sad.

As they were playing, Lily stumbled and fell down. Her friends rushed to help her and asked if she was okay. Lily said she was fine and got up with a smile on her face. They continued playing, but Lily thought the game was boring. She wanted to do something else.

So, Lily suggested they play hide-and-seek instead. Her friends agreed and they had a lot of fun. Lily stumbled a few more times while running, but she didn't mind. She was happy to be playing with her friends and having a good time.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Molly. She was only three years old and she wanted something very special. One day her mommy and daddy offered her a beautiful cushion. It was fluffy and pink and very adorable. Molly was so happy and hugged it tight. She carried it around everywhere, even to her friend's houses. 

Her friends wanted one too and so Molly happily offered hers to them. They all had so much fun playing with their cushions and trying to make the softest and cuddliest one. After a while, the friends put them away, thanked Molly and said goodbye. 

Molly took her cushion home and proudly showed it to her mommy and daddy. They told her that she had been a very kind and generous girl. Molly smiled and went to bed with her cushion. She had the nicest dreams about her cute, adorable cushion. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a brave bumblebee named Baloo. He always knew what was the right thing to do, but one day he didn't know what should happen. Baloo came across a will and he thought it was very useful. He wanted to know what it said so he picked it up and set off.

Baloo soon came across a bear who was his good friend. The bear asked him why he had the will in his hands. Baloo told the bear he thought it was useful. The bear said that the will would only be useful if it was used properly.

The bear then told Baloo that it was important to always do what was right and to think of others before himself. The opinion had an effect on Baloo and he decided to put the will into action and use it for good.

He shared the will with all of his animal friends and with their help, they were able to do great things. Baloo had learned a valuable lesson that day: always think of others before yourself and use the things you find in a helpful and positive way.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the snow. One day, Lily's mom gave her a pair of gloves to wear outside. But Lily didn't like them because they were ugly and didn't match her coat.

Lily's mom said, "Let's measure your hands to make sure we get the right size gloves for you." They found out that Lily needed a smaller size. So, they went to the store and found a pretty pair of gloves that matched her coat perfectly.

Lily was so happy with her new gloves. She played outside in the snow and her hands stayed warm and cozy. From that day on, Lily learned that it's important to measure things to make sure they fit just right.

Once there was a little boy named Jack. He wanted to go outside to play. He put on his warm sweater and went outside. He saw a big tree and he wanted to climb it. He found a branch and he grabbed it. He felt so happy and he used the branch to pull himself up. He climed higher and higher and his heart was beating like thunder. Then he noticed that there were some thick leaves above him. He was very excited and he decided to pull them and see what was underneath. To Jack's surprise, he found a secret nest! He had found the perfect place to stay and keep dry from the rain. It had all been so easy - he only had to pull the leaves and there it was. He was so glad he found it. He stayed at the nest for the whole afternoon, feeling happy and warm. 

When it started to get dark, Jack said goodbye to the nest and went back home. He was so excited to tell his family all about his secret discovery!

Once upon a time, there was a chubby little boy. His name was Jack, and he loved to play. Jack especially loved to soar in the sky.

One day, Jack decided he wanted to stand on top of a hill and imagine himself soaring higher than ever before. He climbed the hill and used his imagination. He imagined he was wearing a red cape and would fly like a bird.

Suddenly, Jack heard a noise. It was a clown down at the bottom of the hill! The clown said, "Hello, young man! Would you like to come and fly with me?"

Jack was so excited to see the clown and he eagerly agreed. The clown held Jack's hands and they both started to soar in the sky. Jack felt like he was flying with a real bird! They soared so high, and then flew lower and lower until they both landed.

Jack thanked the clown for a wonderful day, and the clown said, "You can do it anytime! Whenever you want to feel free, just come back here and use your imagination!" 

Jack smiled, gave the clown one more big hug and went back home feeling happy and so proud of himself.

Jack loved to drive in his car. He loved to go very fast, and when he drove he could be in control. He especially loved to look in the mirror to see how fast his car was going. 

One day Jack took his car out for a drive. He drove it to the park and saw lots of lively children playing. He waved to them as he drove by.

The drive made Jack really happy. He liked to look in the mirror and see the sun shining on his car. He could also see the trees blowing in the wind, and it made him feel even more lively. 

Finally, Jack's parents came to the park in their car. They waved to Jack and he waved back. He knew it was time to go home, but he was still feeling so lively from the drive -- he wished he could stay forever.

Anna was playing in her backyard when she heard something fall. She looked around and saw a big ball rolling down the hill. Anna ran to chase it and suddenly it rolled through a hole in the fence. She followed and found herself in a dark and scary place.

Anna was scared, but she wanted her ball back. She could see a bright light at the end of a tunnel and decided to go toward it. When she reached the end, she saw a scary monster standing in front of a movie screen! Anna was surprised, but she was brave.

The monster smiled and held out her ball. Anna was relieved and ran to catch it. Then the monster said, "Let's watch a movie!" Anna was scared at first, but then she remembered how much she liked watching movies. She smiled and the two of them watched the movie together.

Once upon a time three little kids were playing in the park. They were having so much fun running around and playing silly games. 

Suddenly, one of the kids noticed a modern drain off in the corner of the park. The drain was shiny and silver. The kid ran over to it and began playing with it.

Suddenly, a police officer came over and said, "Hey! You need to behave while you are in the park. We want everyone to have fun but be safe too!".

The kids were a little scared and ran back to their game. They promised to be careful and to behave. After that, they had a great time playing in the park and even checked out the modern drain once more on their way home.

Lily and Ben were playing in the park. They saw a rabbit hopping on the grass. The rabbit was brown and white and had long ears.

"Look, a rabbit!" Lily said. "It is so cute!"

"Can we pet it?" Ben asked.

They ran after the rabbit, but it was too fast. It ran into a bush and hid.

"Where did it go?" Lily wondered.

They looked for the rabbit in the bush, but they could not find it. They heard a noise behind them. They turned around and saw a big dog. The dog was barking and wagging its tail.

"Hello, doggy!" Ben said. "Are you friendly?"

The dog licked Ben's face and made him giggle. Lily smiled and petted the dog's fur.

"Maybe the dog knows where the rabbit is," Lily said.

They asked the dog to show them the rabbit. The dog barked and ran to another bush. Lily and Ben followed him. They saw the rabbit peeking out of the bush. The rabbit looked scared.

"Shh, doggy, don't scare the rabbit," Lily said.

They approached the rabbit slowly and gently. The rabbit realized they were not mean. It came out of the bush and sniffed their hands. They stroked the rabbit's ears and back. The rabbit liked it.

"Wow, the rabbit is so soft and warm," Ben said.

The dog sat next to them and watched. He was happy to have new friends.

They played with the rabbit and the dog for a while. They gave them some carrots and water. They thanked them for being nice.

They realized they had a lot of fun. They hugged the rabbit and the dog and said goodbye.

They went back to their mom and dad. They told them about their adventure.

They said they loved the rabbit and the dog. They asked if they could come back to the park and see them again.

Mom and dad smiled and nodded. They said they were proud of them for being kind and brave.

They went home happy and tired. They dreamed of the rabbit and the dog. They hoped to see them again soon.

One day there was a sun in the sky. It was so big and bright. The sun shone all day and it made everything warm.

But the sun was being ignored. No one wanted to look at it, or even see it. It made the sun very sad. 

So the sun went to the ocean. It was deep and dark down there, and no one ever noticed it. The sun felt safe among the waves. 

But after a while, it was lonely. No one ever came to the deep ocean. 

So the sun went back up to the sky, where it belonged. And this time, people noticed. They looked up and smiled at the sun. 

And the sun smiled back. It felt happy to be noticed again.

Sam and Ben are friends who like to play soccer. They have a ball and two goals in the park. Sam has a new shirt with a star on it. Ben likes the shirt and wants one too. He is envious of Sam.

"Wow, Sam, your shirt is cool!" Ben says.

"Thank you, Ben. My mom gave it to me for my birthday," Sam says.

"Can I try it on?" Ben asks.

"No, Ben. It is mine. You have your own shirt," Sam says.

Ben is angry. He wants to have the shirt with the star. He thinks of a plan. He waits for Sam to kick the ball. Then he runs to Sam and pulls his shirt. He tries to take it off.

"Hey, Ben, stop it! That is not nice!" Sam shouts.

"Give me your shirt, Sam! I want it!" Ben shouts back.

They tug and pull on the shirt. The shirt rips. Sam and Ben both fall down. They look at the torn shirt. They are sad. They have ruined the shirt with the star.

"I'm sorry, Sam. I was wrong. I should not have tried to take your shirt," Ben says.

"I'm sorry, too, Ben. I should have shared with you. Maybe we can fix the shirt," Sam says.

They hug and make up. They go to Sam's mom and ask for help. She sews the shirt and puts a patch on it. The patch has a heart on it. Sam and Ben both like the patch. They thank Sam's mom and go back to the park. They play soccer again. They take turns wearing the shirt with the star and the heart. They are happy. They are friends.

Joe liked to keep busy. He loved finding things and he searched all over the place. One day, he found a trap. Joe thought it was brilliant and he wanted it for himself. He pulled on the handle to open it but it wouldn't move. He kept pulling but still, it wouldn't open.

He decided to ask for help. He went over to his dad and said, "Please can you help me open the trap?" His dad looked at the trap and said, "No, it's too dangerous, Joe. Put it back." Joe said, "But I want to keep it; it's brilliant!" His dad replied, "No, Joe. You have to put it back. It's not safe."

Joe felt angry and pulled the trap harder but it still wouldn't open. He kept pulling until, suddenly, the trap snapped open, but there was something inside! Joe was so shocked that he screamed. His dad rushed over and saw a wild animal inside the trap. He pulled Joe away and said, "See what happens when you don't listen?" Joe sadly nodded his head and they put the animal back in its home in the woods.

One cold morning, an old man was walking through the woods. He had a bag in his hand and was looking around. Suddenly, he noticed a copper coin on the ground. He quickly picked it up and put it in the bag. Just then, he heard a voice.

A little girl was walking towards him. She asked, "Did you take that copper coin?" 

The old man shivered. He couldn't believe it. He looked down guiltily and said, "Yes, I did take it." 

The little girl glared at him. "That's not fair," she said. "That copper coin doesn't belong to you. You should give it back!" 

The old man felt guilty and shivered again. He knew the little girl was right. He gave back the copper coin and apologized to her. The little girl thanked him and walked away.

The old man watched her go. He learned his lesson that day. It was wrong to take something that belonged to someone else.

Once upon a time there was a kind duck. He liked to observe the world around him. He looked with his eyes, ears, and even his nose!

One day he noticed a little pond. He quacked in excitement and waddled over. He observed the pond and saw a lot of different interesting things. He saw green plants and colourful fishes.

The kind duck then noticed a frog. The frog had a long nose. He waddled up to the frog and said hello. The frog croaked back. They became friends, and the kind duck asked the frog to show him around the pond.

The frog hopped away, and the kind duck followed. The two of them explored all around, and the kind duck used his nose to sniff the air. He took in all the wonderful smells of the pond. After a while, they said goodbye, and the kind duck returned home happy.

Sam was a lazy boy who always left his room messy. His mum was tired of it, so one day she said "Sam, it's time to clean up your room!" Sam sighed and started polishing his wallet. He wanted to make it shine.

He worked slowly, as he was quite lazy, but gradually the wallet started to look better and better. He was very proud of his work. 

He showed the wallet to his mum, and she smiled and said "Well done, Sam! You did a great job!" Sam was happy and gave his mum a big hug. 

From that day on, Sam always kept his room tidy. He always took a few minutes to polish his wallet and remind himself of how proud it made his mum.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Ruby. She didn't have a lot of money, but she was very brave. One day,Ruby saw an old shield in the street. She knelt down to pick it up and noticed that it was heavy. 

Ruby decided to take the shield home with her. She got an old stick and used it as a handle. She then took the shield and leaned it against the wall. 

When Ruby went to bed that night, she felt a little bit safer. She knew the shield would help protect her in case anything bad happened. 

The next day, Ruby went to the park with her shield. She was so proud to show it off to her friends. She even pretended to be a knight and ran around, trying to keep everyone safe with her old shield. 

Ruby kept the shield as protection for many years. It made her feel safe and brave, even when things were scary. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a little bird named Nick. He lived in a big cage. But Nick was very sad. He wanted to go out and play but he was stuck in the cage.

One day, Nick thought of a plan. He asked his friend Jane to bring some paints. She agreed and brought lots of paint to the cage. Nick and Jane started to paint the cage. 

At first it was hard but they painted it very quickly. Suddenly, the cage was full of colour! Nick was so happy! He thanked Jane for bringing the paint. 

The next day, Nick opened the door and flew out of the cage. In the sky, he could feel the love of the sun and the wind. Suddenly, he saw a cat! The cat hissed and ran towards him. Nick was scared and he flew quickly away. But as he flew, his wings were hurt. 

Nick flew back to the cage. He was really sad but he was also really happy because his cage was no longer plain and boring. He thanked Jane for bringing the paint again. From that day on, Nick never felt so free in his cage because the colours made it seem less like a cage and more like home.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sadie. She was very sad because her best friend didn't want to play with her anymore. They had a big fight and said mean things to each other.

Sadie felt very lonely and had nobody to play with. She started to weep and her tears sparkled in the sunshine.

Just then, her doorbell rang. When Sadie opened the door she saw her best friend. He was holding a toy for Sadie and apologised for being so rude. 

Sadie smiled because his kind gesture made her happy again. Together they went outside and played in the garden. Sadie was never lonely again and they were always each other's best friend.

Once upon a time, there lived a wealthy man. He had lots of fancy things, such as a big house with lots of toys. One day, he saw a jet in the sky. He was so excited that he wanted to show it to his family and friends.

He took all of his family and friends outside and pointed to the jet. He said, "Look at that! That's a jet!" Everyone was amazed and wanted to know what it was. So the wealthy man explained it to them.

He said, "A jet is a type of airplane. It's very fast, so it can take us to lots of exciting places. Would you like to go on a ride?"

Everyone cheered in excitement and the wealthy man took them all for a ride in the jet. They had the best time flying around and seeing all of the sights. From then on, the wealthy man took his family and friends for rides in the jet whenever he could.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety. Tweety lived in a nest high up in a tree. One day, Tweety's mommy said, "Tweety, it's time for your nap. You need to rest so you can grow big and strong."

Tweety replied, "But mommy, I don't want to nap. I want to play with my friends."

Mommy bird said, "I know you want to play, but it's not safe for you to be awake all the time. You need to rest in your cozy nest so you can be safe and healthy."

Tweety thought about it and decided to take a nap. As he snuggled into his nest, he felt warm and cozy. He knew his mommy was right and he needed to rest. And so, Tweety closed his eyes and took a peaceful nap, dreaming of all the fun he would have when he woke up.

Tom and Ben are brothers. They like to play with their toy cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. Some cars are fast, some cars are loud, some cars are big.

One day, Tom finds a new car in his room. It is a steel car. It is shiny and heavy. It has four big wheels and a long nose. Tom thinks it is the best car ever. He wants to play with it alone.

"Look, Ben, this is my new car!" Tom says. "It is a steel car. It is strong and cool. You cannot play with it. It is only for me."

Ben feels sad and angry. He likes cars too. He wants to play with the steel car. He thinks Tom is not nice. He says, "No, Tom, that is not fair. The steel car is not only for you. It is for both of us. We can share it and play together. That is more fun."

Tom shakes his head. He does not want to share. He says, "No, Ben, go away. The steel car is mine. You have your own cars. Leave me alone."

Ben does not go away. He tries to grab the steel car from Tom. Tom holds it tight. They pull and push. They yell and cry. They fight over the steel car.

Mom hears the noise. She comes to the room. She sees Tom and Ben fighting. She is not happy. She says, "Stop, boys, stop! What are you doing? Why are you fighting over a toy? That is not nice. That is not how brothers should be."

She takes the steel car from them. She says, "This steel car is not for anyone now. It is for the shelf. You cannot play with it until you learn to share and be kind. Now, say sorry to each other and hug."

Tom and Ben feel sorry. They say sorry to each other and hug. They say sorry to Mom too. They understand that sharing is better than fighting. They decide to play with their other cars together. They are happy again. They are good brothers.

Every Saturday, Henry would take his mule to the market to supply things to the people. Henry was a serious worker, always doing his best to make sure his customers got what they wanted.

One sunny Saturday, Henry stopped by Mrs. Tom's stand. She had been a regular customer of Henry's for many years.

Mrs. Tom smiled at him. She said, "Henry, I need some apples for my son. Can you supply me with some?"

Henry patted his mule's head. "Of course I can, Mrs. Tom," he said. He lifted a basket full of red apples off of the mule and handed it to Mrs. Tom.

She thanked him and handed him some coins. "You run a serious business, Henry," she said.

Henry nodded, tipping his hat. "Yes, I take this job very serious," he said. He thanked Mrs. Tom and continued on his way.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Anna. One day, Anna went to the park to play. She looked around and saw a big tree with a measure of hidden leaves. Anna wondered what they were. She went closer and started to question the leaves.

Suddenly, the tree started to whisper a response. The leaves said "Come closer and touch them, they will give you a surprise!" Anna was curious but she was afraid. She took a deep breath and bravely touched the hidden leaves.

To her surprise, Anna suddenly felt scared and cold. She tried to back away but it was too late. Anna realised that the leaves were hiding a monster! The monster grabbed Anna and she screamed for help. Even though she screamed and yelled, no one came. 

The monster flew away with Anna, never to be seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a sweet baby. The baby was happy and went for a walk in the park. As the baby was walking, it saw something on the ground. It was a dry carpet! The baby sat down on the dry carpet and started to giggle.

Suddenly, the baby heard a voice. It was an old man. The old man was dressed in a funny hat and had a big smile on his face. He sat beside the baby and said hello. The baby smiled back and said hello too.

The old man and the baby had a great time together. They talked about different things, laughed and smiled. They even played games together. After a while, the old man said goodbye and the baby said goodbye too.

The baby waved goodbye to the old man and went back home. As the baby was walking, it thought about the wonderful time it had with the old man. Then, the baby realised that it had met someone new and it was happy.

Once there was a boy named Jake. Jake wanted to be a very competitive boy, but he had to test himself first. He needed to prove he had a strong spirit.

One day, Jake went to the park. He saw a big slide and he decided to test himself. He went up the stairs and he sat at the top. His heart was pounding with anticipation.

Jake pushed himself off the slide and he went very fast. But he kept going and he didnâ€™t stop. He felt his competitive spirit grow in him.

When he reached the bottom, Jake was happy. He had passed the test and he knew he was competitive. He gave a big cheer and ran off to find the next thing to test himself on.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved chocolate more than anything in the world. One day, her mommy let her have a big piece of chocolate. It was mighty delicious!

But then, Lily started feeling a little funny. Her tummy started hurting and she felt sick. Her mommy told her that too much chocolate can make you feel sick. 

From that day on, Lily learned that she should only have a little bit of chocolate at a time. She still loved it, but she was careful not to eat too much. And every time she had a little bit, she remembered how mighty delicious it was, but also how important it was to not eat too much.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily who loved to play basketball. She had an organized room with many basketballs. Lily would play with her friends every day.

One day, Lily met a boy named Tom who also loved basketball. They became good friends and played together all the time. But, Tom did not like to be organized. His basketballs were always everywhere, and it made it hard to play.

Lily wanted to help Tom, so she told him, "If you marry me, I will help you be more organized." Tom agreed and they got married. Together, they made a big, happy, and organized basketball family.

Once upon a time, there was a kind teacher who taught at a school. Every day, he brought lots of things to teach his pupils. Even though the pupils were slow, the teacher was patient and taught them carefully.

One day, the teacher gave the pupils a new lesson to learn. The teacher taught them about nature and all the things in it. The pupils listened and tried their best to learn. Even when it was slow, the teacher kept teaching them.

The pupils worked hard and eventually understood the lesson. They were happy and excited about what they had learnt. The teacher was very pleased and smiled at his pupils.

The teacher and his pupils spent the rest of the day playing and having lots of fun. They were all thankful for the teacher's help and kindness. The teacher was happy because he had taught them well.

Once there was a girl named Jane. Jane wanted to learn how to ride a bike. So her mom went outside with her. She put the bike on the ground and told Jane to wait. Jane watched her mom carefully. Her mom taught her how to use the pedals, and how to turn the handlebars. The bike had wide wheels and was a lot to learn. But Jane was brave and listened carefully. Her mom said to practice and wait until she felt ready to try. So Jane practiced and practiced until she felt like she could do it on her own. Finally, Jane was riding the bike on her own! She was so proud. She waved to her mom and thanked her for teaching her. Jane was so happy that she had learned to ride the bike!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy was walking in the park when he stumbled and fell down. He scraped his knee and felt a little sad.

As Timmy got up, he noticed a leak in his water bottle. He was worried that he wouldn't have any water to drink. Luckily, Timmy's mom had packed an extra water bottle for him.

Timmy's friends saw him stumble and came over to make sure he was okay. They saw the leak in his water bottle and helped him get a new one. Timmy was happy to have such kind friends who cared about him.

Once upon a time there was a great little girl named Janey. One night, Janey was very excited because it was foggy outside. She looked out the window in awe of the fog and said to her mom, "Mom, can I go outside? I want to give the fog a hug!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "No Janey, it's too foggy. How about I give you a big hug instead?" Janey smiled and said, "Yes, that's great!" 

So Janey and her mom hugged each other tightly and shared the LOVE! <3

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bears. One day, Lily and her mommy went outside to wait for a taxi. They were going to the park to play on the swings and slide. 

While they were waiting, Lily saw a man who looked grumpy. He was holding a big bag and pacing back and forth. Lily's mommy told her not to talk to strangers and to stay close to her. 

Finally, the taxi arrived and Lily and her mommy got inside. As they drove away, Lily looked out the window and saw the grumpy man getting into another taxi. She wondered where he was going and what was in his bag. But she was happy to be going to the park to play.

The little boy wanted to go to the barn. He took his mom's hand and pulled her in the direction of the barn.

Mom: Where do you want to go?

Boy: Barn!

Mom: Okay, let's go!

They walked in the warm sunshine until they reached the barn. It was a big, red barn. The doors were big and the walls were thin.

The boy had never been to a barn before. He was very excited. He looked around and noticed some chickens in a small cage, a thin horse in a nearby field, and some bales of hay in the corner.

He reached up and touched the door. It was rough and cold. He looked up and squinted, thinking of what was inside the barn.

Mom: Are you ready to take a look inside?

Boy: Yeah!

The boy followed his mom inside the barn. He was so thrilled and excited to explore!

The sun shone brightly on the beach as Mandy and Henry had a grand time playing. They pretended their buckets were pirates and the tide was their ship.

The tide slowly grew and came closer, but the two children laughed harder and harder until Henry noticed something. He looked up and saw a dark cloud in the sky that he hadn't noticed before.

Mandy said, "Don't worry, it'll go by soon. Just be patient." As she said this, she reached out her hand and whispered, "Let's go closer to the water, I want to get a closer look".

Henry wasn't sure but he trusted Mandy and they made their way to the water's edge. Suddenly, a huge wave began to crash on them and Henry screamed.

Mandy quickly reached out and rescued Henry. But alas, it was too late- the tide had taken their buckets and all the fun was gone.

Even though Mandy had been patient and warned Henry about the tide, it was too late for them. They'll never forget that day and the whispers of the tide that foreshadowed their bad ending.

Anna likes to read books. She has many books on her bookshelf. She likes to look at the pictures and learn new words. Sometimes she reads to her teddy bear.

One day, Anna sees a new book on her bookshelf. It is big and brown and has no pictures. It has many words that Anna does not know. Anna does not like the new book. She thinks it is ugly and boring.

She picks up the book and goes to her mom. She says, "Mom, I don't want this book. It is ugly and boring. Can I have a different book?"

Mom looks at the book and smiles. She says, "This book is not for you, Anna. It is for me. It is a book about history. I like to read about history. It is not ugly and boring to me. It is interesting and fun."

Anna frowns. She does not understand why mom likes the book. She says, "But mom, it has no pictures. How can you read it without pictures?"

Mom says, "I can read it because I know many words. When I read the words, I can imagine the pictures in my head. It is like a movie in my head. Do you want to try?"

Anna thinks for a moment. She likes movies. She says, "Okay, mom. I will try. Can you read it to me?"

Mom says, "Sure, Anna. Come, sit with me on the couch. I will read it to you and show you the pictures in my head."

Anna and mom sit on the couch. Mom opens the book and starts to read. Anna listens and tries to imagine the pictures. She sees people and places and things that she has never seen before. She feels curious and excited. She asks mom many questions. Mom answers and explains. Anna and mom have fun reading the book.

Anna learns that books can be different and that different people can like different books. She learns that books can take her to new worlds and teach her new things. She learns that books can be interesting and fun, even without pictures. She smiles and hugs mom. She says, "Thank you, mom. I like this book now. Can we read more?"

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to play with his toy cars and make them zoom around the room. One day, Timmy's mom took him to a big building called a museum. Timmy saw lots of cool things like big bones and shiny rocks. He liked the museum a lot.

But then, Timmy saw a man who couldn't hear anything. His mom told him the man was deaf, which meant he couldn't hear. Timmy felt sad for the man and wanted to help him. So, Timmy took out one of his toy cars and made it zoom around in front of the man. The man smiled and clapped his hands.

From that day on, Timmy always brought a toy car with him whenever he went to the museum. He liked to make them zoom around for the deaf man and make him smile. And Timmy learned that even though someone couldn't hear, they could still have fun and be happy.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to play dress-up and try on different clothes. One day, she found a pretty dress in her closet. It was a modest style dress, with a simple design. 

Lily wanted to make the dress look even prettier, so she decided to mix it up with some accessories. She put on a sparkly necklace and a shiny bracelet. She even found a pair of shoes that matched perfectly. 

When Lily looked in the mirror, she was so happy with her new outfit. She twirled around and danced, feeling like a princess. From that day on, Lily loved to mix and match her clothes to create new styles.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted a sandwich for lunch, but her mom said they had no bread. Lily was sad and hungry. She went outside to play, but she saw a big black bird eating a sandwich. Lily wanted the sandwich, but the bird wouldn't share.

Lily had an idea. She went inside and found some crackers and cheese. She put them together and made a sandwich. She went back outside and showed the bird her sandwich. The bird wanted to eat it, but Lily said no. She told the bird they could share the sandwich if they played together.

The bird agreed and they played together happily. Lily had succeeded in making a sandwich and making a new friend.

Lucy was a three year old girl who loved to jump. Everywhere she went, she was jumping. She was in her yard one day, and saw her house's roof. She saw how high it was, and decided to try and jump onto the roof. 

"I can jump up there!" she said happily.

She started to jump, but just kept falling short. No matter how hard she tried, she just couldn't reach the roof. 

Suddenly, a delicious ice cream truck drove by, and Lucy got an idea. She ran to the truck and bought some ice cream.

With the ice cream in her hand, she started to jump again, and sure enough, she made it onto the roof! She sat atop the roof, eating her delicious ice cream and feeling so proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to wander around his house and play with his toys. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help her with some work. Timmy didn't want to stop playing, but he knew he had to help his mom.

As Timmy was helping his mom, he saw a soft blanket on the couch. He asked his mom if he could play with it. His mom said no because they had work to do. Timmy got upset and started to cry.

His mom asked him what was wrong, and Timmy told her he just wanted to play with the soft blanket. His mom realized that she could make the work more fun by incorporating the blanket into their work. They used the blanket to clean the windows, and Timmy had a blast.

After they finished their work, Timmy's mom asked him if he wanted to go for a wander outside. Timmy was so happy and said yes. They went for a walk and talked about how much fun they had working together. Timmy learned that even though work can be hard, it can also be fun if you make it that way.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to walk on the trail with her dog, Max. Max was very independent and liked to run ahead of Lily. 

One day, Lily and Max went on a walk and they saw a little bird who fell from its nest. Lily wanted to help the bird, so she picked it up and brought it home. 

At home, Lily served the bird some water and food. The bird was very happy and started to feel better. Lily was happy too because she helped the bird. From that day on, Lily and Max went on walks and helped other animals they saw on the trail.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a house with a big white door. Every day, Lily's mommy would cook yummy food in the kitchen.

One day, Lily wanted to help her mommy cook. She put on her apron and stood on a chair to reach the counter. She helped stir the soup and sprinkle salt on the chicken.

After they finished cooking, Lily's mommy opened the white door to let in some fresh air. They sat at the table and ate the delicious food together. Lily was so happy that she helped cook the meal.

One day, Mommy and Daddy were packing. They put a lot of things in different bags. One of them was a log.

"What's that log for?" asked the little boy.

"That's for camping!" the parents replied. "We are going camping!"

The little boy was so excited. He watched as Mommy and Daddy packed the car. They put different things in it, like sleeping bags, clothes, and food.

Finally, everything was packed. Mommy and Daddy put the little boy in the car and off they went. 

The little boy watched as they drove through the countryside. They stopped at a park and got out. Mommy and Daddy set up the tent and the little boy was helping. He was so proud of himself for helping to pack the log! 

Mommy and Daddy said, "You did a great job helping us pack, little one!" 

The little boy smiled and they all went off on their different adventures in the great outdoors.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Clara and her mom. Clara was very sick and her mom wanted to see if her fever had gone down. Clara's mom thought that the best way to do that was to take out Clara's thermometer.

Clara's mom said to Clara, â€œI am going to pull out your thermometer sweetie, so that I can see if your fever is better.â€ Clara nodded and was very calm as her mom pulled the thermometer out of its box.

Once the thermometer was out, her mom smiled, â€œYour fever is much better now, let's go have a nice rest.â€

The moral of this story is - a little patience goes a long way! If we take our time, we can get things done calmly and efficiently. Plus it also encourages positive health outcomes.

Lily had a new toy. It was a puzzle with shapes and holes. She liked to fit the shapes in the holes. It was fun to see the motion of the shapes as they slid in and out.

One day, she wanted to show her toy to her friend Max. She took it to his house and they played together. Max liked the puzzle too. He tried to fit the shapes in the holes. But he did not look at the shapes and the holes. He just pushed and pushed.

Lily saw that Max was not fitting the shapes right. He was making the holes empty. He was breaking the toy. She felt sad and angry. She said, "No, Max, no! You are doing it wrong! You are hurting my toy!"

Max did not listen. He kept pushing and pushing. He broke the puzzle. The shapes and the holes were all messed up. He said, "Oops, sorry, Lily. I did not mean to break it."

Lily cried. She did not want to play with Max anymore. She took her broken toy and went home. She wished she had a new puzzle that fit.

Once upon a time, there lived a curious little girl called Sara. She just turned three and loved to explore her garden.

On one hot day, Sara found a strange loop in the grass. She wondered what it could be used for and said to her mum, â€œWhat is this?â€

Her mum smiled and said, â€œThat's a loop. It's very useful for doing something special.â€

Sara was very intrigued and asked, â€œWhat can I do with it?â€

â€œWatch this,â€ replied her mum as she shut the loop. All of a sudden, the wind stopped blowing and the sun was blocked out. 

Sara was surprised, â€œWow! How did you do that?â€ 

Her mum laughed and said, â€œThe loop is very useful. It can make the wind and sun go away, just like magic.â€

Sara was delighted. She ran around the garden with the loop, experimenting to see what else she could make happen. Her mum smiled and said, â€œThat loop is a very useful tool.â€ 

The End.

Once there was a boy called Tom. He was very thoughtful. He liked to help his Mom and Dad whenever he could. 

One day, Mom was pouring some water into a pot. Tom wanted to help her. He got a cross from his room and gave it to Mom. 

Mom smiled and thanked Tom. She put the cross in the pot with the water. Then she poured some more water. 

When all the water had been poured, Mom took the pot off the stove. She was very happy to see that the cross was still in the pot. She thanked Tom and gave him a big hug. 

Tom was very proud of himself. He had been very thoughtful and his Mom was very happy. 

From that day onwards, Tom made sure to help his Mom and Dad whenever he could. He would always be thoughtful and try to do his best.

Once upon a time, in the summer, there was a boy named Tim. Tim liked to watch the birds fly in the sky. He also liked to watch the flowers grow in his garden. Tim's house was very modern and had lots of big windows to watch things from inside.

One day, Tim went on a walk with his mom. They saw lots of pretty flowers and watched the butterflies fly around them. They also saw a big, modern building with lots of people inside. Tim thought it was very cool to watch all the people going in and out of the building.

After their walk, Tim and his mom went to the park. They watched the kids playing on the swings and the slide. Tim had so much fun watching everything that he didn't even notice when it was time to go home.

The sun was shining brightly and the birds were singing. It was a beautiful day.

But it was getting windy.

"Sally, you should get your umbrella," her mom said. "The wind is blowing."

Sally smiled and ran to get her umbrella. She put on her pink raincoat and opened the umbrella.

The wind was so strong that the umbrella started to move over her head. It was moving faster and faster. It was a race between the wind and the umbrella.

Suddenly, something unexpected happened. As the wind increased in speed, the umbrella started to snag on a tree branch until it snapped off.

Sally watched sadly as the dead umbrella was taken away in the wind. She looked up to the sky and the sun was shining again.

Once there was a bug. It loved living outside with its friends. It was so happy there that it prepared a special picnic. It found a calm spot in the yard and laid out all its food and friends.

The bug invited all the other bugs to join him. He prepared some tasty snacks and flowers to make the picnic even better. All the bugs were very excited and they started eating and playing.

The bug was so happy he had prepared such a fun picnic! Everyone was laughing, playing and eating. It was a peaceful and relaxing afternoon and the bug was so happy.

As the afternoon came to an end, all the bugs said goodbye to each other. They thanked the bug very much for preparing such a wonderful picnic. They all promised to come back soon!

Little Mary was baking in the kitchen with her Mom. Mary's Mom was wearing a pretty white apron and she helped Mary mix flour and sugar together. Mary always liked to sniff the sweet smelling dough, but this time it didn't smell sweet, it smelt sour. Mary made a disgusted face and began to cry. Her Mom put her hands around Mary and tried to make her feel better. She said that accidents happen, and that sometimes you have to start over. Mary wiped away her tears and nodded her head. Her Mom took off her apron and handed it to Mary. With her apron, Mary could mix the ingredients together again. Little by little, she tore the apron into pieces and used it to mix the dough until it smelt sweet again. When it was ready, she proudly showed it to her Mom and together they made the most delicious cookies.

Lily and Ben were playing with water in the garden. They had a big bucket and some cups and spoons. They poured water on the flowers, on the grass, and on each other. They laughed and splashed and had fun.

But then, Lily saw a paper on the table. It was a test that Mom had to do for work. It had many words and numbers on it. Lily was curious. She wanted to see what it was. She took a cup of water and walked to the table.

"Hey, Lily, what are you doing?" Ben asked.

"I want to see this paper. It looks interesting," Lily said.

"No, Lily, don't touch it! That's Mom's test. She needs it for work. She said it was very important. If you touch it, she will be angry," Ben said.

But Lily did not listen. She poured water on the paper. The water made the paper wet and the words and numbers blurry. Lily was surprised. She did not know water could do that. She tried to dry the paper with her hands, but it only made it worse. The paper tore and crumpled.

"Oh no, Lily, what have you done?" Ben cried.

Lily started to cry too. She knew she had done something bad. She was scared of what Mom would say. She ran to Ben and hugged him. She hoped he would help her.

But Ben was angry too. He pushed her away. He did not want to hug her. He did not want to help her. He was afraid Mom would be angry at him too. He said, "Go away, Lily. You are a bad sister. You ruined Mom's test. You are in big trouble."

Lily felt very sad and alone. She wished she had listened to Ben. She wished she had not touched the paper. She wished she had been more gentle. She wished she could say sorry to Mom. But it was too late. The paper was ruined. And so was her day.

Once upon a time there was a boy who wanted to have an amazing adventure. He asked his mom where he should go and she said, "Let's go to the park." He was so excited! 

At the park, he ran around and saw lots of fun things. Then he saw a big hill. He asked his mom if he could go up it and she said, "Let's try it together." 

So they walked up the hill. Halfway to the top, they passed a special tree with a view behind it. His mom said, "This is an amazing view. I recommend you look at it!" So the boy looked and saw a beautiful lake with a rainbow above it. He loved it! 

His mom said, "I think you should go down the other side, it looks like it would be fun!" 

The boy was so excited, so they went down the hill quickly. He had an amazing time, so his mom said, "I definitely recommend you do this again!" 

The boy smiled, and agreed he would come back soon to have another amazing adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a girl with long hair who was playing with her friends. She was having a great time, until a rude man walked up to them. He pointed at her purse and said "Give me that." She got scared and her friends ran away. The girl kept her purse safe and ran away too. When the man realised the girl had run away, he got really mad and started to shout.

The girl ran all the way to her house and when she got there she called her mum. Her mum answered and she said, "Mum, a rude man wanted to take my purse but I said 'no' and ran away!" Her mum was so proud of her for standing up to the man and told her to stay safe inside the house. 

From then on, the girl always held on tight to her purse whenever she went out to play. She had learned a very important lesson that day - never talk to strangers!

Once upon a time, there was a laser. It was very very shiny and it glowed like a star. One day, a little boy saw it and said, "Wow!" He wanted to play with the laser so he waved his hands and the laser moved around. It was so much fun!

The boy played with the laser all day, moving it in the air and making it twinkle. After a while, he was so hungry that he stopped playing and looked around. Suddenly, he saw a tasty treat on the ground. It was a big cookie with a big smiley face. It looked yummy!

The boy got very excited and waved his hands for the laser to come to him. He put the laser on top of the cookie and bam! - the cookie was gone. Where did it go? It flew up in the air and was never seen again! 

The boy was very satisfied and said, "Yum! That was a tasty treat!"  He played with the laser some more and went home with a happy heart.

Sam and Mia are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they find a big sack near a tree. It is black and heavy.

"Look, a sack!" Sam says. "What is inside?"

"I don't know. Let's open it!" Mia says. They pull the sack to a bench and open it.

Inside, they see many shiny things. There are rings, necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. They are all gold and silver and have jewels on them.

"Wow, so pretty!" Mia says. She picks up a necklace with a big red jewel. She puts it around her neck.

"Look, I'm a princess!" she says.

Sam sees a bow and an arrow. They are also gold and have jewels on them.

"Look, I'm a hunter!" he says. He picks up the bow and the arrow. He aims at a bird on a branch.

"Sam, no!" Mia says. "Don't hurt the bird!"

But Sam does not listen. He shoots the arrow. It flies in the air and hits the bird. The bird falls to the ground.

"Sam, you are bad!" Mia says. She runs to the bird. It is not moving. It has blood on its feathers.

"Sorry, Mia. I didn't mean to." Sam says. He drops the bow and the arrow. He follows Mia.

They see a man running towards them. He is angry. He has a mask on his face. He is the thief who stole the sack from the shop.

"Hey, you kids! Give me back my sack!" he says. He grabs the sack from the bench. He pushes Sam and Mia away.

"Help, help!" Sam and Mia shout. They are scared.

A policeman hears them. He sees the thief with the sack. He runs after him. He catches him and puts handcuffs on him.

"Thank you, officer!" Sam and Mia say. They hug the policeman.

"You're welcome, kids. You did the right thing. This man is a bad man. He took these things from the shop. They are not his. They belong to the people who made them and sold them." the policeman says.

He takes the thief and the sack to his car. He drives away.

Sam and Mia look at the bird. It is still not moving.

"Is the bird dead?" Sam asks.

"I think so." Mia says. She is sad.

They bury the bird under the tree. They say sorry to the bird.

They go home. They tell their parents what happened. Their parents hug them and say they are proud of them.

They learn a lesson. They do not play with things that are not theirs. They do not hurt animals. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. Jack loved animals and he had a cow named Daisy. Daisy was a big and tall cow. One day, Jack couldn't find Daisy. He searched everywhere, but she was nowhere to be seen. Jack asked his mom and dad to help him search for Daisy. They searched the whole farm, but they couldn't find her. Jack was very sad and started to cry. Suddenly, they heard a loud "moo" and saw Daisy walking towards them. Jack was so happy to find his tall cow again and gave her a big hug.

Once upon a time, there was a funny owl named Hoot. Hoot loved to make his friends laugh by telling silly jokes. One day, Hoot's friends had an argument and they were not talking to each other anymore. Hoot felt sad and wanted to help his friends unite again.

He flew to each of his friends and said, "Let's be friends again. It's not fun when we're not together." His friends listened to Hoot and realized that their argument was not important. They hugged each other and said sorry.

Hoot felt happy that he could help his friends unite again. He learned that it's important to be a good friend and to help others. The moral of the story is that friendship is important and we should always try to make things right when we have an argument with our friends.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She had a daddy who she loved very much. One day, Lucy and her daddy were playing a game when suddenly daddy vanished! Lucy was so scared and sad, tears filled her eyes.

She searched high and low looking for him but he was nowhere to be seen. Everywhere she looked she saw normal things, like cats and dogs and trees, but no daddy. She felt alone and confused.

But then Lucy noticed a noise. She followed the noise and eventually came to a big red barn. Inside the barn she heard her daddy's voice! When she saw him she smiled and ran to give him a big hug.

They laughed and played happily together. With daddy back Lucy's world felt normal again.

Once upon a time, there was a huge star up in the sky. It was so bright and sparkly, that everyone could see it from far away. Every night, it glowed more and more.

One night, something special happened. The big star started to move. Everyone got excited and followed the star. It stopped in a forest, so they all stopped too.

The star was so big that it made a big hole in the ground. Everyone looked down and could see a tunnel. They all wanted to go inside the tunnel and see what the star had made.

So they all circled around the star and took each others hands. All of a sudden, the big star shot off into the sky! They all shouted and clapped their hands and waited to see what would happen.

After a few moments, the ground started to shake and a bright light came from the tunnel. Everyone ran closer to take a look. In the light was a giant room, filled with colourful stars. Everyone gasped and looked around in amazement. 

Suddenly, the room filled up with laughter, and they all entered the star room. From that day, they all made it a special spot to come and play every night, under the huge, bright star.

Once upon a time, there was a family of four - Pete, his mom, dad and sister. They lived in a big city full of colorful lights. 

One night, Pete and his family went to a park to watch a firework show. It was an unusual night because it was so dark. Pete saw the sky lighting up with colorful lights.

"Wow!" Pete said with a big smile.

The fireworks zoomed up in the sky, moving so fast that Pete could hardly follow them. He clapped in excitement.

"Look how fast they go!" Pete said happily. 

"Don't forget to say thank you," said his mom.

Pete said, "Thank you, fireworks!" with a big smile on his face. 

The End.

Once there was a girl called Spike. Every night she would sleep in her bed and have quiet dreams. One night, when Spike was sleeping, she heard a noise. It sounded like someone was calling her name. 

Spike opened her eyes and saw a tiny fairy hovering next to her bed. She couldn't believe her eyes! 

"Who are you?" asked Spike.

"I'm a magical fairy," replied the fairy. "I've come to grant you a wish! What would you like?"

Spike thought for a minute, then said, "I want to be able to fly like you!"

"Your wish is granted!" said the fairy, with a smile. 

The fairy waved her wand and Spike felt a tingling sensation all over her body. Suddenly, she could fly! She soared up into the sky and saw the stars twinkling above her. 

Spike flew back to her bed and snuggled under the covers. That night, she had the best sleep ever.

Once there was a girl named Sam. She had a pink hand. She liked to use her pink hand to do many things. One day, she went outside with her hand. She was having so much fun that she forgot to come back inside. 

Her mom called out to her, but she couldn't hear. She kept playing and playing. Her mom had to go out and get her! She found her playing with some friends. 

When Sam saw her mom, she ran down to give her a hug. But when she hugged her mom, she remembered what she had forgotten. She completely forgot that it was getting late and she had to go back home. 

Her mom gave her a gentle reminder, and then they both held hands and went back home. Now, Sam remembers to come back home before it gets dark.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lola. She had beautiful, long, light hair.

One day, Lola wanted to record a video of her special haircut. She didn't have enough light to see the video, so she asked her mum to turn on the light.

When Lola saw the light, she started to record the video. Her mum cut her hair till it was nice and short. When she was finished recording the video, she gave the camera to her mum.

Lola looked in the mirror and was so happy with her new haircut. From that day on, Lola always wanted to record videos of her new haircuts.

The End

Once upon a time there was a little boy, who was named Jack. One day he had an adventure to the forest. When he was there, he saw a big soft bear. The bear said hello to Jack. Jack was scared and ran away. 

The next day, Jack returned to the forest. He was a little bit scared, but he wanted to be brave. He wanted to say thank you to the soft bear. So, he slowly walked over. 

When Jack thanked the bear, it was so pleased. The bear gave Jack a big hug. Jack was so happy. 

Jack learned a valuable lesson that day. He found out that when we are kind, good things often happen. From then on, Jack always thanked people who were kind to him. 

This story shows that we should always thank the people who are nice to us. Kindness often comes back to us, if we show it to others.

Once there was a little boy who was 3 years old. He was getting ready to go to his first class. He was a bit scared, but he was excited too. He couldn't wait to learn new things.

When he got there, he saw that there was a really elderly lady helping people. He walked up to her and said "Hello." She smiled at him and said "Hi there". She asked him if he was ready to try his first class and he nodded excitedly. 

The class was lots of fun. He learned about numbers and animals and colors. He tried his best to learn everything and the elderly lady was very proud of him.

At the end of the class, he was very proud of himself. He had tried his best and had learned lots of new things. He couldn't wait to show his parents what he had learned.

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn mule. He lived on a farm near a big bridge. The mule was so stubborn that no matter how much the farmer tried, he couldn't get the mule to move.

One day, the farmer went for a walk. As he reached the bridge, he started to whistle. The mule heard the whistle and started to walk towards it. He was so excited to get to the farmer that he crossed the bridge and ran to the farmer's side.

The farmer was so happy to have the mule back with him. They both walked back over the bridge, the mule no longer stubborn. Every day after that, the farmer would whistle and the mule would come running. They were the best of friends.

Sally saw a perfect tree in her backyard. She was excited and wanted to climb it. She grabbed a hold of the trunk and started to climb.

Halfway up the tree, she saw a worm. It was round and wiggling. She wanted to touch it, so she reached out and touched it gently. The worm wriggled around and then crawled away.

She kept on climbing, until she reached the top. From up there, she could see everything. The view was perfect!

She smiled and hugged the tree. Then, she carefully climbed down. Before she went inside, Sally looked up at the tree and thanked it.

Once upon a time there was a lady who had a big dream. She wanted to carry her dream far away and make it come true. Every day the lady tried hard to make it happen, but the dream seemed so far away.

One day a kind man saw the lady trying so hard. He went to her and said, "Do not feel ashamed, I will help you carry your dream". The lady was so thankful to the kind man and together they began to make the dream come true.

Soon, the dream came true and the lady was so happy. The kind man had helped her in a very important way and she will always be thankful for his help.

This story teaches us that we should never feel ashamed to ask for help. Sometimes, asking for help can make our dreams come true.

Once there was a boy named Tim. He was three years old and very happy. Tim loved to explore the world around him, and he did it a lot. One day, he saw something very special. It was a modern carâ€“shiny, new and cool. Tim's face lit up with a big smile as he admired it.

Then, before he knew it, Tim was behind the wheel. He excitedly moved his hands around, pretending that he was driving. Time flew as he imagined himself zooming around and having adventures in the modern car.

Finally, Tim's mom came to the rescue. She told him it was time to go home. Tim was a bit sad but then he smiled again when his mom promised to take him out for a ride in the car some day. Together, they left for home with a big smile on Tim's face.

Once there was a pretty flower. It was a stubborn flower, and it refused to bloom. No matter how much it was watered, it would not open up.

The flower's neighbour was an old pan. One day, the pan had an idea. He asked the flower why it wouldn't bloom, and the flower said it had forgotten how.

So the pan decided to help. He suggested the flower should be watered with a special mixture, with just the right amount of sun and cool air.

The flower was sceptical, but decided to give it a try. And soon enough, it bloomed! Its beautiful petals shone in the sun, making everyone around smile.

The stubborn flower had learnt to bloom, thanks to its helpful neighbour, the old pan!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she saw a shiny rock on the ground. It made her smile because it was so pretty and it shone in the sun.

When Lily went back inside her house, she went to the refrigerator to get a cold drink of water. She opened the door and felt the cold air. It made her shiver, but she was happy to have a nice, cold drink.

Later that day, Lily went back outside and found that the shiny rock was still there. She picked it up and put it in her pocket. She knew that it would make her smile every time she saw it shine.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. Jane was only three years old, but she was already very clever. Every morning Jane went to school to learn new things.

One day her teacher said to her, "Today I want to teach you something special, Jane." Jane was so excited. Her teacher said, "I want to teach you about zippers!"

Jane asked, "What's a zipper?" Her teacher said, "A zipper is a fancy word for something that opens and closes. It's like a little road."

So Jane's teacher showed her a zipper on his shirt and started to explain how it works. Then Jane's teacher said, "Now, zippers aren't just found on clothes. They can also be found on other things, like bald people's heads."

Jane was so confused. She asked, "What do bald people use zippers for?" Her teacher smiled and said, "Bald people use zippers to keep their heads warm. It just goes to show that you can use your imagination to find new uses for things you already know."

This story teaches us that with a little imagination and creativity, we can find new and useful ways to use the things we already know.

Once upon a time there was a great corn farm. Every day, Farmer Tucker worked to make the corn grow. One day, after a long day of working in the sun, Farmer Tucker became very tired. He decided to take a nap in the shade of a big oak tree.

When Farmer Tucker began to fall asleep, he heard a rustling in the corn field. Farmer Tucker opened his eyes to see what was happening. Much to his surprise, Farmer Tucker saw a family of raccoons munching on the corn! Farmer Tucker shouted and clapped his hands and the family of raccoons scampered away.

Farmer Tucker was relieved, but still very tired. He decided to take another nap, but this time he made sure to lock up the corn nice and tight. He lay down under the big oak tree and before he knew it, he was fast asleep.

After a long nap, Farmer Tucker felt refreshed and ready to go back to work. He was surprised to find that the family of raccoons hadn't done too much damage after all. Farmer Tucker smiled, thanking his lucky stars for great corn fields.

Once upon a time there was a kid called Joe. Joe liked to keep his room tidy and organised. One day, his friend came over to play in his room. Joe showed his friend all his neat toys, but then they started to quarrel over them.

"That's my toy!" shouted Joe. 
"No, it's mine!" shouted his friend back.

The two of them were having a big quarrel and they couldn't agree. Joe started to get upset and began to cry. 

Just then, his mum came into the room. She saw the two kids quarreling and she knew she had to do something.

She sat them both down and said, "Now, now. It's alright to play with the same toys, but you must take turns. That's the only way to be fair." 

Joe and his friend both agreed to be fair. Then they started to play nice and have fun with Joe's tidy room.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bounce on her bed all day long. One day, her mommy told her they were going to the airport to see her grandma. Lily got very excited and her face turned pale with joy. 

At the airport, Lily saw lots of big planes with wings that could flap like birds. She wanted to bounce on the runways, but her mommy said it wasn't safe. They went inside the airport and Lily saw lots of people with bags and suitcases. She bounced up and down with excitement, waiting for her grandma's plane to arrive. 

Finally, her grandma arrived and they hugged each other tightly. Lily's face turned red with happiness. They went home and had lots of fun bouncing on the bed together. Lily was so happy to see her grandma and she knew it was going to be a great day. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a stubborn puppy named Max. One day, Lily's teacher asked her to measure her pupil's height. Lily was confused and didn't know what to do. 

She went home and asked Max, "Max, do you know how to measure?" Max barked and wagged his tail. Lily took that as a yes and brought Max to school the next day. 

When her teacher asked her to measure her pupil's height, Lily used Max to measure. She placed Max next to her pupil and saw that Max was taller. 

Her teacher was surprised and asked, "How did you measure with your puppy?" Lily proudly replied, "Max helped me measure!" 

From that day on, Lily was known as the girl who measured with her puppy. And Max became the school's favorite pupil.

Once upon a time, there was a big, fat bear named Coal. Coal loved to eat honey and berries, but one day he ate too much and felt very full. He sighed and decided to take a nap. While he was sleeping, some mischievous squirrels snuck into his cave and stole his honey. When Coal woke up, he was sad and hungry. He looked everywhere for his honey but couldn't find it. Finally, he asked a friendly rabbit for help. The rabbit showed Coal where the squirrels had hidden the honey and Coal was very happy again. From then on, Coal learned to only eat a little bit of honey at a time so he wouldn't feel so full and sleepy.

Alice and Lenny were in the park when they heard splashing. They ran over to the pond and saw a mole swimming. It was having trouble swimming, so Lenny decided to dive in and help the mole.

Lenny: "Don't worry, little mole. I'll help you."

He quickly dove into the water and grabbed the mole. He pulled the troubled mole to safety. Alice laughed and gave Lenny a big hug.

Alice: "You're so brave, Lenny!"

Lenny smiled and looked at the mole.

Lenny: "Do you want to come and play with us?"

The mole shook its head and ran off through the grass. Alice and Lenny laughed and went back to their game.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a big idea to make a special cake for her mommy's birthday. She went to the store to buy some flour and sugar, but she didn't have enough money. Suddenly, a wealthy lady saw her and gave her some money to buy the ingredients. 

Lily went home and started making the cake. She mixed the flour and sugar together and put it in the oven. While the cake was baking, she got very tired and decided to take a nap. She slept for a long time and when she woke up, the cake was ready! 

Lily decorated the cake with lots of pretty flowers and brought it to her mommy. Her mommy was so happy and surprised by the delicious cake. Lily felt very proud of herself and happy that she had such a good idea. She went to sleep that night with a big smile on her face.

Tim and Jen are friends. They like to play with blocks. They make a tall tower with the blocks. They are happy.

"Look at our tower!" Tim says. "It is so tall!"

"Yes, it is!" Jen says. "We are good at making towers!"

But then, a big dog comes. The dog is black and white. The dog likes to run and jump. The dog sees the tower. The dog wants to play.

"Whoof!" the dog says. "What is this?"

The dog runs to the tower. The dog jumps on the tower. The tower falls down. The blocks go everywhere. Tim and Jen are sad.

"Bad dog!" Tim says. "You broke our tower!"

"Go away!" Jen says. "You are not nice!"

The dog is sorry. The dog does not want to make Tim and Jen sad. The dog wags his tail. The dog gives Tim and Jen a lick. The dog winks at them.

"I am sorry," the dog says. "I did not know. I just wanted to play."

Tim and Jen look at the dog. The dog looks cute. Tim and Jen are not sad anymore. They smile.

"It is okay," Tim says. "We can make another tower."

"Yes, we can," Jen says. "But first, let us play with you."

Tim and Jen hug the dog. The dog is happy. They play together. They have fun. They finish playing. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted to have fun. He found a unique mirror in the corner of his bedroom and he was very excited. He started looking at the mirror and he saw a funny face.

The boy thought the mirror was amazing and he wanted to play a game. He suggested that the mirror show him a different face, and the mirror did! The boy was so happy, he kept suggesting different faces, and the mirror kept showing them to him. 

The boy laughed and clapped every time he saw a new face in the mirror. Soon, he began to see a lot of different faces and he realised that the mirror was very special. He was very proud to own such a unique mirror and he was sure his friends would love it too. 

The boy kept playing and the mirror kept showing him new faces, and he was having the best time.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a goal to find his lost toy. He searched everywhere but couldn't find it. He felt sad because he really needed it to sleep. 

One day, Timmy saw a black cat in his backyard. The cat looked at him and meowed. Timmy thought the cat might know where his toy was. So he followed the cat. 

The cat led Timmy to a bush where his toy was hiding! Timmy felt happy and hugged his toy. He thanked the black cat for helping him find his toy. From that day on, Timmy knew that if he ever needed help, he could always ask the black cat.

Lila and Ben were playing in the sand. They liked to make shapes and animals with their hands and buckets. Lila was very creative. She made a big castle with towers and flags. Ben made a long snake with eyes and teeth.

But then, a big boy came and kicked their sand shapes. He laughed and ran away. Lila and Ben were sad and angry. Their sand shapes were broken and messy.

"Why did he do that?" Lila asked. She did not understand why someone would be so mean.

"I don't know," Ben said. He did not like the big boy.

They looked at their sand shapes. They wanted to fix them, but they did not have enough sand.

"Maybe we can make something else," Lila said. She had an idea.

"What?" Ben asked. He liked Lila's ideas.

Lila pointed to some shells and rocks on the beach. "We can use these to make new shapes. They are harder and prettier than sand. The big boy can't break them."

Ben smiled. He thought that was a good idea. He followed Lila to the shells and rocks. They picked some and started to make new shapes. They made a star, a flower, a fish, and a heart. They were happy and proud of their work.

They did not let the big boy ruin their fun. They were creative and smart. They had a good time playing in the sand.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy cube that she loved to play with. One day, Lily noticed something weird about her cube. It had a funny pattern on it that she had never seen before. 

Lily's mom came into the room and saw her daughter looking at the cube. She asked Lily what was wrong, and Lily showed her the weird pattern. They both looked at it for a while and then Lily's mom said, "Let's clap for your cube! It's still a fun toy even if it looks different now." 

So, Lily and her mom clapped for the cube and then Lily went back to playing with it. She realized that even though it looked weird, it was still just as fun to play with as before. From that day on, Lily loved her cube even more because it was unique and special.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink juice because it was sweet and tasty. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a big glass of juice to drink. Lily was so happy and drank it all up. 

After drinking the juice, Lily wanted to play. She loved to act like a princess and dance around. But her mommy told her to be careful because she might fall and get hurt. Lily listened to her mommy and was very careful while she played. 

Soon it was time for bed and Lily was very tired. She snuggled up in her cozy bed and fell asleep. When she woke up in the morning, she was excited to have more juice and act like a princess again. The end.

Once there was a clever cricket called Jack. Every morning Jack would take a bath at the same time. He would jump in the water and have lots of fun. 

One day, Jack was very excited. He wanted to take a bath earlier than usual. So he set off early to the pond. 

When he got there he noticed the water was much clearer and the sun was shining brighter. Jack was so pleased, he couldn't help but jump right into the pond and start bathing. 

He had lots of fun and enjoyed splashing the water around. He stayed in the pond for a long time, but then he remembered he had to do something else. Jack hopped out of the pond and was on his way. 

Jack was very happy he had managed to take an extra bath. He knew he had been extra clever and he couldn't wait to tell his friends about it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and her teddy bear. One day, her mommy came home with some news. She said that Lily's grandma was coming to visit.

Lily was so happy! She loved her grandma very much. When her grandma arrived, Lily ran to her and gave her a big hug. But then, her grandma said that her leg hurt. Lily was sad to hear that her grandma was in pain.

So, Lily decided to help her grandma feel better. She brought her a soft pillow and a warm blanket. She also gave her a big hug. Her grandma felt much better and thanked Lily for being so kind. From that day on, Lily knew that hugs could make people feel better when they were hurt.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going to the beach and playing in the sand. One day, Timmy and his friend Jack went to the beach to play. They built a big sandcastle together.

Suddenly, Jack accidentally turned over the bucket of water and the sandcastle became messy. Timmy was upset and didn't know what to do. Jack apologized and suggested they build a new sandcastle.

Timmy agreed and they started building a new sandcastle. This time, they were more careful with the water and made sure not to turn it over. They had so much fun building the new sandcastle and forgot all about the messy one. The end.

John liked to study. He was very smart for a 3 year old. He loved to go to school and learn new things. One day, John left school and saw a big, red house. It was so pretty. He wanted to learn more about it, so he did some studying. He asked his dad all sorts of questions. He learned that the house was built many years ago and was a special home for a family. John thought this was so cool. He loved learning new things and wanted to know even more. He vowed to himself to keep studying and keep learning.

Once there was an old ranch near a small town. The ranch was dull and empty, but the townspeople still visited it all the time.

One day, a little girl named Sarah and her mother went to the ranch. As they walked, Sarah noticed something strange. There were all kinds of new, colorful things on display.

"What is this Mommy?" asked Sarah in amazement.

"It's a carnival, Sarah," replied her mother. She explained that the carnival was full of fun games, tasty food, and amazing rides.

Excited, Sarah and her mom had a great time. They played the games, ate candy apples and even rode the Ferris wheel. Before they knew it, their fun day was over.

The carnival only stayed at that old, dull ranch for a few days. Then it moved on, but the memories of their trip stayed with Sarah and her mother forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved parades. He would watch them every year with his mommy and daddy. This year, Timmy wanted to be in the parade. He needed to be in the parade.

Timmy worked hard on his costume. He made a big hat with feathers and painted his face with colors. He was so excited to show everyone his costume in the parade. The day of the parade came, and Timmy was ready. He marched with the other people in the parade. 

Suddenly, Timmy saw a big truck coming towards him. He tried to move out of the way, but it was too hard. The truck hit him, and Timmy fell down.
