His mom said, "Spot, it is nice to share with others." Spot knew his mom was right. He gave some sausage to his sister. They both ate the delicious sausage and were happy. Spot learned that sharing is good.

Once upon a time there was a smart bear. He was walking in the forest and he saw a newspaper lying in the grass. He stopped and picked it up. He looked at it and thought "this looks interestingâ€. 

Bear then turned it over and saw a picture of a balloon on the other side. He smiled and said "oh what fun, I'd like to fly in one of those one day". 

Suddenly, he heard a voice from above. He turned and saw a bird high up in the trees. The bird said, "I fly in my balloon all the time, it's so much fun. You should give it a try Bear!"

Bear smiled and nodded his head. He said, â€œyes, I think I will. I will be smart and give it a try!â€

The bird said, â€œGood choice! Tomorrow I'll come back and bring my balloon. We can go for a ride together.â€

Bear was delighted and excited. He could hardly wait for tomorrow. He said goodbye to the bird and ran off to tell his friends.

The next day, the bird came back and they took off on the balloon ride. Bear loved it, he was so happy and amazed. He had a really fun day and learned that being smart and trying new things is really exciting.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty dress with buttons on it. One day, she was playing outside and she accidentally lost one of her buttons. She was so careless!

But then, her mommy found the lost button and fixed Lily's dress. Lily was very happy and wanted to celebrate. So, they had a party with cake and balloons. Lily even wore her pretty dress with all the buttons.

From that day on, Lily learned to be more careful and not lose her buttons again. And every time she wore her pretty dress, she remembered the fun party they had to celebrate the fixed button.

Once upon a time there was a friendly boy. He loved to make sandwiches. Every day, he would take out two slices of bread and mix in some of his favourite goodies. He would carefully put the slices together to make the perfect sandwich. One day, he was walking down the street, sandwich in hand, when the friendly neighbourhood bully approached him. "Hey! Give me that sandwich, or else!" the bully said.

The boy trembled with fear, but he refused to give up his sandwich. "No, it's mine!" he replied.

The bully was angry. He growled and reached out to grab the sandwich. The boy screamed and tried to run away, but the bully was too fast. He snatched the sandwich away and ran off, leaving the friendly boy alone, with no sandwich and with tears in his eyes.

On Sunday, a bald man came to visit the family. He was tall. Everyone said hello. The bald man raised his arms. He said, "I am here to help!" He had a big box and in it was a puppy. Everyone cheered. The puppy was so small and wiggled around! Mama said, "Let's go outside and raise the puppy together." So they went outside and played with the puppy. They all laughed and gave him many hugs and cuddles. The puppy and the bald man were now part of the family. From then on, every Sunday was a special day for them.

Once upon a time, there was a pick. The pick was very sharp. It was important because it could do lots of things.

The pick was so sharp it could open things. It could also help fix things that were broken.

One day, a little girl wanted to use the pick. She was excited and wanted to know what it could do.

She picked up the pick and found it was very sharp. She used it to open the door to the garden. She was very happy when the door opened.

The pick was so important that the little girl kept it close by. She used it every day for special jobs. She was very careful with it and made sure it stayed sharp.

Once upon a time, there was a rabbit named Bob. Bob was very lazy and never wanted to do anything. One day, Bob's friend, a squirrel named Sally, came to visit him. Sally brought some vegetables to share with Bob.

Bob looked at the vegetables and said, "No, thank you. I don't want to eat vegetables. They're yucky."

Sally replied, "But vegetables are good for you. They make you strong and healthy."

Bob thought about it for a moment and decided to try some vegetables. He realized they were actually quite tasty! From that day on, Bob started eating vegetables and became stronger and healthier.

The moral of the story is that it's important to share and try new things, even if we don't think we'll like them at first.

One day, Tom was riding on his bike. He had big pedals and he was happy to try to make himself go faster. He had his eyes on the big hill in the distance, and he was determined to make it to the top.

Tom pushed down on the pedal with all his might, and the bike moved faster and faster. Then he zoomed up the hill, and made it to the top! He was so successful!

As he was coming back down the hill, he kicked his feet up in the air and made a silly sound. He was so excited and happy. He had made it to the top of the hill and it felt so good!

Tom was so happy with himself. He was proud of what he had achieved, and he vowed to try it again. He was sure the next time he would be even more successful!

One day, Tom and his dog Max were going on an adventure. Tom put on his shoes and grabbed his knapsack. He dropped in a smooth wooden stamp he had found at the beach.

Max ran ahead and found a big rock he wanted to explore. As they were walking, a gust of wind blew and the wooden stamp dropped out of Tom's knapsack. Tom quickly picked it up and said â€œWow! It's so smooth!â€ 

Tom continued walking and soon he came across a river. It was the perfect spot to play. Max jumped into the water and Tom sat on the edge of the riverbank with his smooth stamp. He picked up a few rocks and carefully dropped them into the river. 

He smiled as he watched the ripples created by the rocks. Tom spent the rest of the day playing with Max and exploring until it was time to go home. He gently put the wooden stamp back in his knapsack, ready for his next adventure.

Once upon a time there was a sleepy dolphin. He swam in the warm ocean every day looking for food. One day, he saw a boat sailing in the distance. He decided to go and explore it.

When he got close enough, he saw a bunch of people on board and they were all smiling. They waved at high at him and the dolphin was so happy.

The people threw a net into the water and the dolphin helped them catch some fish. They were so pleased with his help, they invited him onto the boat.

The people served the fish to the dolphin and he ate it all up. They played with him for a bit and then the dolphin said goodbye before swimming off into the sunset.

The dolphin was so happy and he thanked the people for serving him delicious food. He also thanked them for being so kind and friendly. From that day on, he was no longer a sleepy dolphin.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jenny. She loved to skip in the park. One day as she was feeling happy, she saw a big lollipop lying on the grass. Jenny ran over and picked it up.

"It's mine now," she said, taking a big lick. 

Suddenly, an old man with a frown on his face approached her. "That's my lollipop," he said in a stern voice.

Jenny felt ashamed. She was too embarrassed to say anything and just gave him the lollipop.

The old man thanked her. He said, "You should never take something that doesn't belong to you."

Jenny nodded. "I'm sorry," she said, and ran off to skip in the park. 

From then on, Jenny remembered the old man's words. She always asked permission before taking things that weren't hers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play outside. One day, she went to the park with her friend, Timmy. They played on the swings and the slide, but after a while, Lily got bored.

"Lily, what's wrong?" asked Timmy.

"This is boring," replied Lily. "I wish we had something fun to do."

Timmy had an idea. "I know a joke!" he said. "Why did the chicken cross the road?"

"Why?" asked Lily.

"To get to the other side!" said Timmy, laughing.

Lily laughed too, but then she saw a rope on the ground. "Let's play jump rope!" she said.

They started jumping, but Lily tripped and fell. She got tangled in the rope and couldn't get up. Timmy tried to help her, but it was too late. Lily had accidentally hung herself with the rope. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an angry lion. He was very big and strong. The lion roared through the forest. He was so mad that he shook the ground.

The lion had not eaten for days. He was very hungry. Everywhere he looked, he saw nothing to eat. 

Then, the lion saw something very strange. It was a pink bunny. The bunny was hopping around, looking for something to eat. The lion got very excited. He took a big leap and chased after the bunny. 

The bunny ran very fast, but the lion was faster. He got close very quickly and roared loudly. The bunny was so scared that it stopped moving. 

The lion was very hungry. But he was also very kind. He let the bunny go. Instead, he found a big apple tree and ate all the apples. He was satisfied and happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a green potato. All day long, he would lean against the wall in the kitchen. He was content to stay in one spot, until one day a family of mice came along.

The mice were very excited to see the green potato leaning against the wall. They asked him to come with them on an adventure. The potato leaned and said yes!

So off they went, the potato and the mice. They traveled through the forest, looking for something fun to do. Soon they stumbled upon a pond. The potato decided to lean down and take a peek at the pond. He was amazed by all the different creatures he saw!

The potato and the mice played in the pond for the rest of the day. Eventually, the sun started to set and it was time to head home. The green potato leaned against the wall once again, content and happy with his adventure.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jake. Jake lived by a big ranch and he loved visiting it every day.

One day, Jake got scared when he heard a loud noise coming from the ranch. He ran away and hid in his mom's closet.

When his mom found him, she asked him, "What is wrong, Jake?".

Jake answered, "I heard a loud noise from the ranch and it scared me."

His mom said, "It's ok, just be brave and let's go see what it was".

When they got to the ranch, they saw that it was just a big windy storm.

Jake felt better, and he was no longer scared.

Once there was a little boy and he loved to jump. He wanted to jump so high he could reach the clouds. One day, he had an idea and he called out to the sky.

He said, â€œI want to jump as graceful and high as any bird!â€

The sky answered back, â€œThat is a great idea. Here, I have a scale. You can measure how high youâ€™re jumping.â€ The little boy was so excited and he grabbed ahold of the scale and began to jump.

He jumped and jumped, and with each jump the scale would go higher and higher. The little boy was so proud of himself for being so graceful and for jumping so high.

He knew that he was getting very close to being able to jump as high as any bird. He knew if he just kept jumping, he would get there soon.

The little boy was so happy and he thanked the sky for giving him the scale to help him measure his jumps. He kept on jumping and jumping, feeling more and more graceful each time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who liked to count. She counted everything, from the leaves on the trees to the stars in the sky. Today, her mommy made her some sour toast for breakfast. The little girl was clever, so she decided to count the pieces of toast. She counted one, two and three. After she ate the toast, her tummy felt so good!

Next, the little girl wanted to count something else. She thought and thought and finally she got an idea. She wanted to count the pets in her house. One by one, she counted her cats and her hamster. When she was finished counting, she hugged them all and had a happy smile on her face.

Finally it was time to go to bed. The little girl was tired, so she snuggled into her bed and started to count sheep. One, two, three...she was soon fast asleep.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her backyard. One day, she saw a butterfly and she started to chase it. She ran and ran until she reached a big garden full of colorful flowers and herbs. She stopped to gaze at the beautiful flowers and smelled the sweet herbs.

Suddenly, she saw a snake hiding in the grass. The snake was very dangerous and Lily knew she had to be careful. She slowly backed away and ran back to her house to tell her mom. Her mom was proud of Lily for being brave and telling her about the dangerous snake. From that day on, Lily always remembered to be careful when she played outside.

Once upon a time, there was a sad little girl who had lost her chalk. Everywhere she looked, she couldn't find it. She looked in the toy box, in the closet, and everywhere else. But the chalk was gone.

The little girl asked her mom, "Mommy, have you seen my chalk?"

But her mom said, "No, I'm sorry dear, I haven't seen your chalk."

The little girl was very sad. She went outside to look for her chalk. As she was looking, she saw a bad man. He was carrying her chalk! He had stolen it!

The little girl asked the bad man, "Please give me back my chalk!"

But the bad man just laughed. He stuffed the chalk into his pocket and ran away.

The little girl was very sad. She started to cry.

The little girl never saw her chalk again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Rose. She loved to explore the world around her. One day, she decided to explore a new garden. As she walked around, she noticed a beautiful rose. She wanted to get a closer look, so she reached out to pick it up. But it was too high! Just when she was about to give up, she noticed a bee carrying the rose in its wings. She took a deep breath and jumped. She was able to grab the rose, and carefully lifted it up â€” triumphantly!

The rose had a spicy scent, and Rose just couldn't get enough of it. She took the rose inside and decided to give it Water to keep it fresh. She was so proud of herself! She taught herself that no matter how tricky something looked, it was possible with enough determination and courage. 

From then on, Rose was never afraid to lift anything, no matter how big or small it was. She believed that she could get anything she set her mind to.

Once upon a time, there was an ugly pond. It was very deep and had slimy green water. All of the animals around kept away from it.

One day, a man came to the pond with an old box. He had a shovel too. He dug a big hole in the ground, near the pond. Then he put the box in the hole and covered it up with the dirt. He was burying something.

When he was done, a big bird came flying to the pond. It looked down at the man and the ground where he had buried the box. The bird was wondering what was in the box.

The man said nothing and left. He left the bird and the ugly pond behind him. And the mystery of what was buried in the ground stayed unsolved forever.

Lily and Tom were best friends. They liked to play in the park in summer. They liked to slide, swing and run. They also liked to pretend they were lions. They would roar and chase each other.

One day, they saw a big dog in the park. It was black and furry. It had sharp teeth and a loud bark. Lily and Tom were not afraid. They thought they could scare the dog away. They ran towards the dog and roared like lions.

The dog did not like their roar. It did not think they were lions. It thought they were annoying. It growled and snapped at them. Lily and Tom were scared. They turned around and ran away. But the dog was faster. It caught Tom by his leg and bit him hard.

Lily screamed and ran to get help. She found a grown-up and told him what happened. The grown-up called an ambulance and the police. They came and took Tom to the hospital. They also took the dog away.

Lily was very sad. She wished she had been more thoughtful. She wished she had not roared at the dog. She wished she had stayed away from it. She hoped Tom would be okay. She hoped they could still be friends. She hoped they could still play in the park in summer. But she knew things would not be the same. She knew they had made a big mistake. She knew they had learned a hard lesson.

Yesterday, I went to the park with my mommy. We walked and played on the swings. I saw a big white dog and it was so fluffy. I wanted to pet it, but it ran away. Then, we went to sit on a bench and eat our snacks. Mommy said, "Let's seat here and enjoy the sunshine." We had a fun day at the park!

Once upon a time, there was a group of friends who loved to play together. One day, they went to the park to play hide-and-seek. But one of the friends, named Timmy, didn't want to play fair. He kept peeking and cheating. The other friends felt sad and angry.

So, they decided to punish Timmy by not letting him play with them anymore. Timmy felt sorry and said sorry to his friends. He promised to play fair from now on. His friends were grateful and forgave him. They played together happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a little duck who loved to play in the sunshine. But one day the weather was very difficult. The sky was dark and cloudy and it was too rainy to go outside.

The little duck was sad and did not know what to do. He wanted to play, but the bad weather was delaying his plans. He tried to think of something else to do but nothing seemed very fun.

Then suddenly, the rain stopped and some of the clouds moved away. Suddenly there were blue skies!

The little duck was very excited and flew outside as fast as he could. He was happy to be able to enjoy the sun again and he spent the rest of the day playing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on adventures with her mommy and daddy. One day, they went to a car store to buy a new jeep. Lily saw a shiny red jeep and pointed to it. "Mommy, daddy, that one!" she said.

But her parents said, "That jeep is too expensive. Let's look for a cheaper one." Lily was sad, but then she saw a blue jeep that was just as cool. "Look, mommy, daddy, that one!" she said, pointing again.

Her parents looked at the blue jeep and agreed that it was a good choice. They bought the jeep and went on a fun adventure together. Lily loved her new jeep and pointed out all the cool things they saw on their trip. "Look, mommy, a bird!" she said. "And a flower! And a tree!"

Once there was a soldier who wanted to pay for a surprise. He had to be flexible so he searched everywhere for the right thing. He found a wonderful toy that was perfect. He paid the storekeeper and put the toy in his pocket. 

On the way home, he started to worry because the toy did not look very sturdy. Suddenly, he saw a big tree. He had an idea! He took out the flexible toy and tied it to the tree. It was perfect! 

Now, when he came back home with the surprise, he waited for the smile on his friends face. The soldier had paid for a wonderful surprise!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Elizabeth who was three years old. She was walking in the park one day when she noticed something exciting. She saw a big machine and went to take a look closer. She saw that it was a massage machine. She was eager to try it out and lay down on the bed.

Suddenly, the machine started to move and the bed started to shake.

"Wow!" Elizabeth said with a big smile.

The machine then started to give her a massage. It felt so good. Elizabeth was so happy and couldn't wait for her massage to finish.

When it was done, she thanked the machine then went to find her mommy.

"Mommy! I had a massage!" Elizabeth said excitedly as she hugged her mom.

Her mommy smiled and said, "That's great, darling! I'm glad you enjoyed it." 

Elizabeth smiled back, eager for next time.

Ben is a boy who likes to play with his dog, Rex. Rex is a big dog who can run fast and catch balls. Ben and Rex are best friends. They like to go to the park and have fun.

One day, Ben and Rex go to the park with Ben's mom. Ben's mom has a bag with meat and bread for lunch. She puts the bag on a bench and tells Ben and Rex to stay near her. But Rex smells the meat and wants to eat it. He runs to the bench and jumps on the bag.

Ben's mom sees Rex and shouts, "No, Rex! Bad dog! Leave the meat alone!" But Rex is deaf. He cannot hear Ben's mom. He only hears his tummy. He rips the bag and takes the meat. He runs away with the meat in his mouth.

Ben sees Rex and runs after him. He calls, "Rex, come back! Drop the meat! You are in trouble!" But Rex is deaf. He cannot hear Ben. He only sees the meat. He runs to a hill and eats the meat.

Ben's mom runs after Ben and Rex. She is angry and worried. She catches up with Ben and hugs him. She says, "Ben, are you okay? Rex is a naughty dog. He should not take the meat. He should listen to us." But Rex is deaf. He cannot hear Ben's mom. He only feels happy. He licks his lips and wags his tail. He loves Ben and Ben's mom. He thinks they are the best.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big tap in the park. The tap is ugly. It is brown and rusty. It has a hole in it.

Tim and Sam want to see what is in the hole. They go near the tap. They hear a noise. It is a hiss. They are scared. They think it is a snake.

They run away from the tap. They find a bench. They sit on the bench. They are safe. They are happy.

But then, they see something. It is not a snake. It is water. The water comes out of the hole. The water is fast and strong. The water hits the tap. The tap breaks. The water goes everywhere.

Tim and Sam are wet. They are cold. They are sad. They do not like the tap. They do not like the water. They want to go home.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, Lily's mom gave her a soft teddy bear to play with. Lily hugged the teddy bear and played with it all day long. 

But then, Lily accidentally dropped her glass of juice on the teddy bear. The teddy bear was all wet and sticky. Lily was sad and said, "Mommy, my teddy bear is broken. Can you fix it?" 

Lily's mom smiled and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I can fix it." She took the teddy bear and washed it with soap and water. Then, she put it in the dryer to make it soft again. When the teddy bear was dry, Lily hugged it tightly and said, "Thank you, Mommy. You fixed my teddy bear." 

From that day on, Lily learned to be more careful with her glass of juice. And whenever something got broken, she knew that her mommy could fix it.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved exploring. 

One day, Jack was playing in the park when he discovered a secret box buried in the sand. He opened it and it revealed a new sock! He was excited to share his new discovery with his mom, so he quickly ran home.

When he arrived, his mother said, "What do you have there, Jack?" 

Jack replied, "Look Mom, I found a new sock in the park!" 

His mom smiled and said, "That's fantastic! Why don't you put it on your foot and show it off?"

So Jack proudly put on his new sock and ran around the house showing all his friends his new discovery. Everyone congratulated him and cheered for him. 

Jack was so proud of his new sock, he never wanted to take it off!

Once upon a time, there was a clever little girl. She went on a nice walk with her mom. As they were walking, they came across a big tree with its branches gently blowing in the wind.

The little girl saw a big rope tied to the tree. She was very curious and asked her mom, "What is that?" Her mom said, "It's a rope". The little girl asked, "What does it do?". Her mom explained, "It's like a tie. It holds things together".

The little girl was so intrigued. She ran to the tree and grabbed the rope. She tried to tie a knot, but she couldn't do it. She felt so frustrated!

But then she had an idea. She asked her mom to help her. Together, they tied a knot, and when it was done, the rope was securely closed around the tree. The little girl was so proud of herself. She was so clever!

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Suzy. She loved to go on safaris. One day, Suzy hopped on her bike and began pedaling fast. She wanted to go on the best safari she could find.

On her way, Suzy stopped by a soft meadow full of colorful flowers. When she stepped out of her bike, a tiny baby rabbit hopped over to greet her. Suzy smiled and held out a carrot for the little bunny.

An hour later, Suzy and her new friend continued on their safari. Suddenly, there was a loud noise in the sky. Suzy looked up and saw a huge, colorful rainbow! The soft colors were so beautiful that Suzy felt her heart fill with joy. 

The rainbow seemed to be changing all the time. Suzy and the baby rabbit stayed and watched until the sun went down. When they finally went back home, Suzy had remembered a wonderful safari full of adventure and change.

Once upon a time there was a mom and a dad who were getting ready to go on a trip. They were getting married so they needed to hurry and get everything packed. The dad looked around their house and said they needed lots and lots of money because a marriage can be very expensive. He told his wife that they needed to start packing right away.

The mom and dad gathered all the things they needed and put them in their suitcases. Dad told the kids to hurry and get dressed, so they rushed to put on their neatest clothes. They said goodbye to their house, getting in the car, and setting off on their way.

When they arrived, they saw that the marriage was a fancy one. Everything was so pretty and expensive. The mom, dad, and kids all waited in line to go and get married. When it was their turn to go up, they clasped hands and got married. 

The family then hugged and kissed each other. They were so happy to be married and together. The dad said that this was the best thing he ever did and everyone agreed. They were so glad they hurried and got everything done in time to get married.

Once upon a time, there was a little birdie. The birdie loved to play and sing in the trees. One day, the birdie got very dirty and needed to take a bath. So, the birdie flew to a nearby pond and took a nice bath.

After the bath, the birdie flew back to the trees and saw a delicate butterfly resting on a pole. The birdie wanted to say hello to the butterfly, but didn't want to startle it. So, the birdie chirped softly and the butterfly woke up.

The butterfly and the birdie became friends and played together on the pole. They had so much fun together and promised to play again soon. From that day on, the birdie always made sure to bathe before playing with its delicate friend on the pole.

One day, a small boy saw a bookcase. He was so excited and wanted to stay with the bookcase. He ran over to it. The boy found that the bookcase was small, but it had lots of books inside. He started to take them out one by one and look at them. He especially liked the one with colorful pictures. He wanted to read it but he couldn't since it was too hard.

The boy learned that the best thing to do was to stay and look at the bookcase. He would look around for a while and read the colorful pictures in the book. He was happy and content.

Then the boy had an idea. He decided to make his own bookcase. He thought and he thought. He was so excited with his idea that he went and got some wood and tools and started to build it.

When he was done, he stepped back and looked at it. He was so proud of his work. It was small but he liked it just the same. He put some books he had been given into it and was so happy. Now, he could stay with his own bookcase and read the books whenever he wanted. He liked it so much that he never wanted to leave it again.

Once upon a time there was a mom and a dad that wanted to have a picnic. They were very organized and invited some friends to join them. When it was time to go to the picnic, the mom checked the thermometer. It said it was too hot outside! The mom and the dad were so sad they couldn't have the picnic they wanted to have. 

They decided to try and find something else to do. The mom saw a sign for a water park and thought that might be good fun instead. They invited their friends and went to the water park. They had a lot of fun swimming and playing. Everyone was happy and the mom and dad were glad they could find a plan B for their picnic.

One day, a big loud hurricane hit Betsy's town. It was so loud that everyone had to cover their ears. Suddenly, it felt like the house was vanishing! Everything that Betsy could see was being sucked away by the storm. 

Betsy's mom came running into her room. "We have to go now, Betsy!" she said urgently.

Betsy was very scared and asked, "Where are we going? Will we be safe?"

"Yes, of course," her mom replied.

So they all quickly grabbed their things and vanished, just like the hurricane had taken away all the other things in town.

They were safe, but Betsy would never forget how loud the hurricane was, and how it felt like it was taking away everything.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Every Sunday, she would wake up fast and happy because she loved going to the park with her family. She would swing and slide and play with her friends. 

One Sunday, Lily saw a little bird with a hurt wing. She cared about the bird and wanted to help it. She gently picked it up and brought it to her mommy. They took the bird to the vet and it got better. 

From that day on, Lily felt happy every Sunday because she knew she could make a difference in the world by caring for others, even if they were just little birds. The end.

Once upon a time there was a friend. His name was Jack. Jack was very fierce. He liked to growl like a tiger.

One day Jack went to the park with his friend. As they were walking around they heard a loud noise. It sounded like someone was in trouble.

Jack and his friend ran over to see what was happening. They saw a tiger near a little girl. The tiger was growling.

Jack was brave. He stepped forward and said, "Go away, tiger! You're too fierce for this girl."

The tiger listened and left. The girl was safe.

Jack and his friend were happy. They smiled and hugged each other. They had saved the day!

Once there was a little girl named Sarah who was very lucky. One day, Sarah was outside playing when a big and magical grape appeared in the sky. It grew and grew until it became as big as a house! All the kids on the block were amazed and wanted to take a closer look. 

So Sarah decided to take the brave step and climb the big grape. When she made it to the top, Sarah discovered that the grape was filled with lots and lots of magical candies! She was so surprised and excited, she quickly started eating them. 

The other kids were left behind and watched on as Sarah appeared to them as a lucky girl! From then on, Sarah always brought her friends over to share in her special luck. They laughed and snacked on the magical candies from the giant grape and shared in all the wonderful surprises it brought them.

Once upon a time, there was a bird named Billy. Billy was a happy bird who loved to fly. One day, Billy saw a butterfly and said, "Hello, butterfly! Do you want to fly with me?"

The butterfly said, "Yes, please! I want to soar like you!"

So, Billy and the butterfly flew together. They heard a noise and saw a plane in the sky. Billy said, "Wow, that plane is loud! It makes a lot of noise."

The butterfly said, "I am too weak to fly that high. I like to stay close to the ground."

Billy said, "That's okay. We can still have fun flying together!" And they continued to soar through the sky, enjoying their time together.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo loved to swim in the big blue ocean. One day, Nemo saw a shiny object and swam towards it. It was a seashell!

Suddenly, a crab named Charlie appeared. "Hi there, Nemo! That's a very pretty seashell you have," said Charlie. "Let's have a competition. We'll spin around and whoever spins the most wins the seashell."

Nemo agreed, and they both started to spin. Nemo spun and spun until he couldn't spin anymore. "I think I won!" exclaimed Nemo. "You're right, Nemo. You're a very competitive fish," said Charlie. Nemo was so happy that he won the seashell, he swam away with it and added it to his collection of treasures.

Once upon a time, there was a big, magical crystal. It was very beautiful and sparkly. All the people in the land loved it.

One day, a bad creature stole the crystal. Everything looked dark and gloomy without it. The people were very sad.

The people did not give up. They all worked together to find the original crystal. They asked all the creatures and looked high and low, but still, they could not find it.

Finally, they found a clue. It said the crystal was hidden in a deep cave. The people were so excited! 

They all gathered together and went off to find the crystal. After a long journey, they finally reached the cave and carefully searched it. Amazingly, they found the original crystal! Everyone was so happy and relieved.

The people brought the crystal back to their land and it sparkled as bright as ever. From that day on, the people of the land always kept the crystal safe and guarded it with love.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with cards. She had a charming deck of cards that she would always carry with her. One day, she met a boy named Jack who also loved cards.

"Can I join you?" Jack asked.

"Yes, you can!" Lily replied.

The two of them played cards together and had a lot of fun. But then, Jack got very angry when he lost a game. He grabbed Lily's charming deck of cards and tore them all up.

Lily was very sad and cried. She learned that sometimes it's not safe to join with others who might not be kind.

Lila and Sam were playing in the sand. They liked to pretend they were explorers in the desert. They had a big hat, a water bottle and a map.

"Look, Sam, the map says there is an oasis over there!" Lila said, pointing to a green spot on the paper.

"Let's go and see!" Sam said, excited. They got up and started to walk.

But the sun was very hot and the sand was very dry. They felt thirsty and tired. They wished they had a camel to ride.

"Maybe we should crawl, like snakes," Lila suggested. "It might be cooler and faster."

"OK, let's try," Sam agreed. They dropped to their knees and began to crawl on the sand.

They crawled and crawled, but the oasis seemed very far away. They wondered if it was real or just a picture.

"Are we there yet?" Sam asked, panting.

"I don't know," Lila said, squinting. "I think I see something green."

They crawled a little more, and then they saw it. It was an oasis, a small pool of water with some palm trees and grass. It looked like a paradise.

"Wow, we made it!" Lila exclaimed, smiling.

"Yay, we did it!" Sam cheered, clapping.

They ran to the water and splashed their faces. They drank some water and felt refreshed. They saw some brown dates hanging from the trees and picked some to eat. They felt happy and proud.

They decided to rest under the shade of the palms. They spread their hat on the ground and lay down.

"This is the best adventure ever," Lila said, cuddling with Sam.

"I agree," Sam said, closing his eyes. "You are the best explorer ever."

They fell asleep, dreaming of more adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play by the river. She liked to watch the water flow and listen to the birds sing. One day, Lily's mommy asked her if she wanted to go on a boat ride down the river. Lily was very excited and said yes.

But mommy wanted to make sure they were safe on the boat, so she asked her friend who knows a lot about boats to recommend a reliable one. Her friend said she knew just the right boat and they set off down the river. Lily had so much fun waving at the ducks and feeling the wind in her hair. She was so happy mommy found a reliable boat.

Sam and Mia are twins. They like to play in the backyard. But sometimes they fight over toys. One day, they see a big pile of laundry on the grass. It is Mom's laundry. She is hanging it on the line to dry.

"Look, a mountain!" Sam says. He runs to the laundry and jumps on it. He makes a big mess.

"Hey, stop that!" Mia says. She runs after him and tries to pull him off. "You are ruining Mom's clothes!"

"No, I'm not!" Sam says. He pushes Mia away. "It's fun!"

They start to fight. They pull and push and shout. They are fierce. They do not see Mom coming.

"Sam! Mia! What are you doing?" Mom says. She is angry. She sees her laundry all over the ground. Some of it is dirty and torn.

"Sorry, Mom," Sam and Mia say. They look down. They are ashamed.

Mom makes them pick up the laundry and help her wash it again. She tells them to be nice to each other and share their toys. She says fighting is bad.

Sam and Mia hug and say sorry to each other. They promise to be good. They learn their lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a man named Mr. Mustache. He had a big, bushy mustache that made him look very silly. One day, he went on a trip to a faraway place that was very distant. He wanted to teach the people there about his mustache.

When he arrived, the people were very curious about his mustache. They had never seen anything like it before! Mr. Mustache was happy to teach them all about how he took care of it and how it made him feel special. The people were amazed and wanted to grow their own mustaches just like his.

After spending some time in the distant place, Mr. Mustache had made many new friends. They all had big, bushy mustaches too! He was happy to have taught them something new and to have made so many new friends. And with that, he said goodbye and headed back home, feeling proud of his mustache and the new friends he had made.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who didn't like naps. Each day, he would try to talk his mom out of making him take a nap. He thought that naps were not fun and he didn't understand why he had to take them.

Mom always had the same opinion about naps. She told him that naps were good for him and would make him feel better during the day. But the little boy was not convinced, no matter how many times she told him.

One dark, rainy day, the little boy finally decided to take a nap. Just as his mom said, he felt much better afterwards. From then on, he decided to take a nap whenever it was dark and rainy outside. He always took his nap with a smile!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was three years old and loved to explore the world around her. 

One day, she went outside to play and found a mosquito. She wanted to tie the mosquito, so she found a piece of string and tied it around the mosquito's feet. 

The next day, she decided to take her mosquito for a picnic. She spread a blanket and tied a delicious sandwich to the blanket. She then tied the mosquito next to the sandwich so it could enjoy the picnic, too. 

Sally and the mosquito spent the rest of the day eating the delicious sandwich and enjoying the summer sunshine. They had a wonderful time together!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a charming smile and loved to play with her toys. One day, Lily's mom gave her a special toy that she had been wishing for. Lily was so happy and grateful.

As Lily played with her new toy, she accidentally broke it. She felt sad and didn't know what to do. Then, her mom told her to pray and ask for help. Lily closed her eyes and prayed for a little while.

Suddenly, Lily's mom came into the room with a surprise. She had fixed the toy and it was good as new! Lily learned that when things go wrong, she can always pray and things will work out in the end.

Once there were two friends named Bob and Jack. Bob had built a very tall tower with lots of blocks. Jack was very proud of him and wanted to play too. 

Jack said to Bob, "Can I help you build the tower?"
Bob said, "Sure!"

So they worked together to build the tower together until it was very tall. Then they both relaxed and admired their work.

Bob asked, "Can I show you something special?" 
Jack said, "Yes!"

Bob showed Jack his special network. He had connected all the blocks together in a very neat pattern. Jack was very proud of Bob. 

They relaxed and enjoyed the day playing with their tower. They were happy and proud of their work.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who hated green. Everywhere she looked she saw green; the leaves on the trees, the grass in the park, and even her finger was green.

She wanted her finger to be different. Every day she wished for the green to go away. Until one day, something amazing happened! Her finger was no longer green. It was yellow!

She was so happy. Now she could pretend to be a canary and sing sweet songs. Everywhere she looked was still green, but she was ready to face the world with her yellow finger!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved going on car rides with her mommy and daddy. One day, they were driving in the city and they got stuck in traffic. Lily's mommy said, "Oh no, we're stuck! We need a modern solution to this traffic problem."

Lily asked, "What's 'modern'?" 

Her mommy replied, "It means new and better. We need a new and better way to get through this traffic." 

Suddenly, they saw a big building with a gate. Lily's daddy said, "I know a way to get out of this traffic. We can take a shortcut through this building, but we need to lock the gate behind us so no one follows us." 

Lily said, "I can help! I can lock the gate!" So they drove through the gate and Lily locked it behind them. They made it through the building and avoided the traffic. Lily was so happy she could help her family.

Once upon a time, there was a fireman named Jack. He was a very brave man who loved to help people. One day, Jack was walking down the street when he saw a little boy who was lost. Jack asked the boy where he lived, but the boy didn't know. Jack decided to help the boy find his way home.

As they were walking, they saw a big fire. Jack knew he had to help, so he ran towards the fire. The little boy was scared and asked Jack if he was going to be okay. Jack just shrugged and said, "I'll be fine, don't worry."

Jack ran into the burning building to save the people inside. He was able to save everyone, but he got hurt in the process. When he came out of the building, the little boy was waiting for him. The boy asked if Jack was okay, but Jack just shrugged again and said, "I'm fine, don't worry."

The little boy went to get help, but when they came back, Jack was gone. He had died from his injuries, but he was remembered as a very brave and modest hero who saved many lives.

Lily and Max were playing in the park. They liked to search for shiny things in the sand. Sometimes they found coins, buttons, or beads. They put them in their pockets and showed them to their mom.

One day, they saw something very shiny in the sand. It was a gem. It was orange and sparkled in the sun. Lily and Max ran to pick it up.

"Wow, look at this!" Lily said. "It is so pretty!"

"Can I see?" Max asked. He reached for the gem, but Lily held it tight.

"No, it is mine!" Lily said. "I saw it first!"

"But I want to see it too!" Max said. He tried to grab the gem, but Lily pulled it away.

They started to fight over the gem. They pulled and pushed and shouted. They did not see the big dog that came near them. The dog saw the gem and thought it was a ball. He barked and jumped and snatched the gem from Lily's hand. He ran away with it in his mouth.

Lily and Max stopped fighting. They looked at the dog and the gem. They felt sad and sorry.

"Come back!" Lily cried. "That is our gem!"

"Bad dog!" Max yelled. "Give it back!"

But the dog did not listen. He ran to his owner and wagged his tail. He dropped the gem at his feet and licked his face.

Lily and Max ran after the dog. They tried to get their gem back, but the owner picked it up and put it in his pocket.

"Sorry, kids," he said. "This is my dog's toy. He likes shiny things too."

He walked away with the dog and the gem. Lily and Max looked at each other. They felt sad and angry.

They hugged each other and said sorry. They decided to share their other shiny things. They went back to the sand and searched for more. They hoped to find another gem someday.

Timmy was having lots of fun playing with his toy train. He made it chug and zoom all around his bedroom. Suddenly he heard the sound of a real train outside. He was so excited!

Timmy grabbed his toy train and ran out of the house. He followed the sound of the train and ended up at his uncle's farm. There, he saw a beautiful, real train chugging along the tracks.

Timmy watched the train for a long time and almost forgot to eat. But his tummy grumbled and he knew it was time for lunch. Timmy's uncle gave him some food from a nearby diner and he ate it with a big smile.

After lunch, Timmy felt a bit dizzy. He still wanted to ride the train, so his uncle helped him board it. He sat in the passenger car and watched the train speed away until his eyes became so sleepy that he fell asleep. When he woke up, his uncle told him the train ride was over. Timmy was sad, but he had a big smile on his face as he remembered his exciting adventure.

There was a boy and a girl. They had a nice day and were excited to explore the outside world. So, they went out and walked around. The girl saw something in the grass and stopped to take a closer look. It was a magazine!

The boy stopped too and they both examined it. The magazine was very fragile. It felt soft, almost like it was made of paper. The boy and girl were careful with it and decided to take it home.

When they got home, they put the magazine on the table. They read the magazine happily together and the girl thought it was really interesting. After looking at the magazine for a while, the girl was inspired to do something creative.

They went to the kitchen and made a collage out of paper and the magazine. It was beautiful and the girl was so proud of her work. They were both very happy and had a great day exploring.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the beach with her family. One day, they went to a restaurant that had oysters on the menu. Lily had never tried oysters before, but her dad insisted that she should give them a try.

Lily was hesitant at first, but her dad was very helpful and showed her how to eat the oyster. She took a bite and was surprised at how good it tasted! From that day on, Lily insisted on ordering oysters every time they went to the beach.

Her family was happy that Lily tried something new and they all enjoyed eating oysters together. Lily felt proud of herself for being brave and trying something new. She knew that being helpful and trying new things can lead to great adventures!

Tom and Lily were playing in the living room. They liked to pretend they were pirates and knights. Tom had a wooden sword and Lily had a paper hat. They ran around the sofa and the table, making loud noises.

"Yield, you scurvy dog!" Tom shouted, waving his sword at Lily.

"Never! I am the bravest knight in the land!" Lily said, holding her hat on her head.

They chased each other until they bumped into a vase on the shelf. The vase wobbled and fell to the floor. It broke into many pieces. Tom and Lily stopped and looked at the mess. They felt ashamed.

"Oh no, we broke Mom's vase!" Tom said.

"What will we do?" Lily said.

They heard Mom coming from the kitchen. They quickly hid behind the sofa. They hoped Mom would not see the vase.

"Tom, Lily, what are you doing?" Mom said, entering the living room. She saw the broken vase on the floor. She looked angry and sad.

"Who did this?" Mom said.

Tom and Lily peeked from behind the sofa. They saw Mom's face. They felt more ashamed.

"We did, Mom. We are sorry. We were playing and we bumped into it." Tom said.

"We didn't mean to break it. It was an accident." Lily said.

Mom sighed. She went to the sofa and pulled Tom and Lily out. She hugged them.

"I know you didn't mean to break it, but you have to be more careful. The vase was very special to me. It was a gift from Grandma. You have to respect other people's things." Mom said.

"We are sorry, Mom. We respect your things. We love you and Grandma." Tom and Lily said.

"I love you too, my sweeties. But you have to help me clean up this mess. And no more playing pirates and knights in the living room. You can play in your room or outside." Mom said.

"Okay, Mom. We will help you. And we will play somewhere else." Tom and Lily said.

They helped Mom pick up the pieces of the vase. They felt sorry for breaking it, but they also felt glad that Mom forgave them. They learned their lesson. They decided to make a card for Mom and Grandma to say sorry and thank you. They hoped they would make them happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear who loved to wear a red jacket. But one day, the zipper on the jacket broke and the bear couldn't wear it anymore. The bear tried to fix the zipper but he couldn't. 

The bear went to his friend, a rabbit, and asked for help. The rabbit knew how to fix zippers and he improved the zipper on the bear's jacket. The bear was happy and thanked the rabbit. 

But later that day, the bear was walking in the forest when he saw a hunter. The hunter saw the bear's red jacket and thought it was a target. The hunter shot the bear and the bear fell down. The zipper on the bear's jacket was still working perfectly, but it was too late. The bear had died. 

The rabbit was sad and missed his friend, the big bear. He knew that he had improved the zipper on the bear's jacket, but he couldn't stop the hunter from shooting the bear.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane was 3 years old and loved to explore. One day, Jane asked her mom, "Can I go outside and explore?" Her mom said, "Yes, but don't go too far!"

Jane smiled and said, "Okey dokey!" She put on her coat and ran outside. She saw the sun, the trees, and the flowers -- her eyes sparkled! Jane made her way to the park.

Once she arrived, she noticed a group of kids playing. One of them said to Jane, "Hi, do you want to play too?"

Jane shrugged and replied, "I don't know how to play." The kids laughed and said, "It's easy! We'll show you."

So the kids taught Jane how to play. She listened carefully and before she knew it, she was having a really good time! And they all lived happily ever after. The End.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She was so sad and her eyes looked very gloomy.

One day, she went to the castle to ask for help but no one was there. Lucy's heart felt heavy and full of trouble.

So, she knelt down and started saying "Please help me! I'm so sad and I don't know what to do".

Suddenly, a magical fairy appeared in a ray of sunshine. The fairy looked at Lucy and said, "It's ok, don't worry. I will help you."

The fairy cast a spell that made Lucy's heart lighter. She smiled and thanked the fairy with a big hug.

The next day, Lucy awoke feeling happy and excited. She ran around the castle singing a happy song. No more gloominess or trouble!

Thanks to the magical fairy, little Lucy was happy once again.

One morning, a little girl named Lily saw a shiny toy at the store. She wanted it so much, but it was too expensive. She asked her mom if she could buy it, but her mom said no.

Lily was sad and started to cry. Her mom hugged her and said, "Lily, we can't buy everything we want. Sometimes we have to save our money for more important things."

Lily thought about what her mom said and realized she didn't need the expensive toy. She laid it back on the shelf and said, "Mom, you're right. I don't need this toy. I'm happy just being with you." Her mom smiled and hugged her again, proud of her daughter for learning a valuable lesson.

One evening, Daisy looked outside her window and saw a big, bright moon. She was so excited that she skipped outside with her special polishing cloth. Daisy wanted to make the moon sparkle and shine so she used gentle strokes to polish the moon's surface. Every time Daisy moved her cloth, the moon twinkled even brighter in the sky. When Daisy was finished, the moon was glowing so brightly she had to use her hands to protect her eyes. Daisy smiled with joy and she decided to polish the moon every night.

Once upon a time there was a pretty figure. She was shiny and sparkly and all the other figures wanted to be like her. Every day she would go on special adventures, looking for things that were special and beautiful.

One day she came across a rock. It didn't look like the other rocks but it had a special sparkle in the middle. The figure knew that it was going to be extra special. She put it in her pocket and took it with her wherever she went.

The other figures wanted to know about the rock. They asked the figure why she valued it so much. She told them that the sparkle inside was very special to her. She said that it reminded her of how special and pretty she was.

The figure was proud of her rock. She always went on adventures with it and kept it safe. All the other figures saw how much it meant to her, and they valued it too.

Once upon a time, there were two friends â€“ Daisy and Tim. Daisy was very enthusiastic about going to the opera. She loved the music and watched performances every chance she could get.

One day, Daisy told Tim about the opera and said, "Letâ€™s race to the opera. Who can get there the fastest?" Tim smiled and said, "I'm in!"

They ran down the street as fast as they could, dodging the other people on the sidewalk. Eventually they arrived at the opera house, giggling and panting. Daisy said, "I won!" They laughed and hugged each other, excited to watch the performance. 

The show was amazing. They were so enthusiastic and cheered every time the performers sang. They watched until the curtains fell and waved to the performers as they walked off the stage. 

As they walked out of the theatre, Daisy said to Tim, "That was so much fun. We should race to the opera again soon!" Tim smiled and said, "Letâ€™s do it!"

Once upon a time, there was a kid named Timmy. Timmy was very fragile and always had to be careful not to hurt himself. One day, Timmy was playing with his favorite toy when his friend Billy came over. Billy wanted to play with Timmy's toy, but Timmy didn't want to share. Billy started to question why Timmy wouldn't share, but Timmy just got upset and said no.

Billy didn't like that Timmy wouldn't share, so he decided to take the toy anyways. Timmy got very upset and started to cry. Billy realized that he shouldn't have taken the toy and apologized to Timmy. Timmy forgave Billy and they played together with the toy. From then on, they always shared their toys and never had any more conflicts.

Once upon a time, there was a prince who was very smart. He wanted to find a magic crown. The prince searched high and low but he couldn't find it.

One day, when the prince arrived at the beach, he finally found what he was looking for. In the sand was a beautiful, golden crown! The prince was so happy that he quickly picked up the crown.

He couldn't believe his luck and hurried home to show his parents. When he arrived, his mom and dad were so proud of him. They hugged him and said he was so smart to have found the crown!

So the prince was crowned king. He moved into the palace and was so happy. From then on, the people of the kingdom loved their new king. They knew he was the right man for the job.

Once upon a time, there was a pilot named Tim. Tim was very organized and always made sure his airplane was clean and ready to fly. One day, Tim had a cold and he started to sneeze a lot. 

While Tim was flying his airplane, he sneezed so hard that his hat flew off. He tried to catch it, but it was too late. His hat flew out of the window and into the clouds. 

Tim was sad that he lost his hat, but he knew he had to keep flying. He landed safely and went to get a new hat. From then on, Tim made sure to always hold onto his hat tightly, even when he sneezed. The end.

One day, Jack went to the beach. He wanted to meet an oyster. He put his hand out and said hello.

Suddenly, a little oyster poked its head out from under the sand. Jack was happy. He said, "Hello, little oyster!"

The oyster said, "Hello, Jack. Are you here to meet me?"

Jack smiled and nodded. He said, "Yes, I've been looking everywhere for you. I wanted to talk to you."

The oyster grinned. "Well, I'm glad you came. I've never talked to anyone before!"

Jack and the oyster talked for a long time. They shared stories and laughed a lot. When it was time for Jack to go, the oyster said goodbye with a wink.

Jack smiled and waved. He said, "Bye, little oyster!"

Once there was a little girl who wanted to practice balancing. She thought it would be fun.

She tried to balance on one foot while her other foot was in the air. It was tough, but she kept trying. With lots of practice, she started to get better and better.

The girl asked her friends for their opinion. They said balancing was really tricky and she was doing a great job. She was so proud of herself.

The little girl kept practicing and soon she was able to stay balanced on one foot for a long time. She was amazed at what she had achieved.

This little girl showed that she was tough and with lots of hard work and practice, she was able to do something amazing.

Tom and Lily liked to play in the garage. They found many things to make fun games with. There were boxes, cans, ropes and tools. Sometimes they pretended to be pirates, or astronauts, or spies.

One day, they saw a red button on the wall. They did not know what it did. Tom said, "Let's press it and see what happens." Lily said, "No, don't do that. It might be dangerous." But Tom did not listen. He ran to the button and pushed it hard.

Suddenly, the garage door opened. It was very loud and fast. Tom and Lily were scared. They tried to run away, but it was too late. The door came down and smashed them. They vanished under the door.

Mom and Dad heard the noise. They ran to the garage. They saw the door closed and the red button lit up. They did not see Tom and Lily. They shouted their names, but there was no answer. They lifted the door and looked under it. They saw blood and bones. They screamed and cried. They lost their children. They wished they had never put the red button in the garage.

Once upon a time, there was a little town. In this town, there was a regular house. In this house, there lived a nice family. The family liked to play and have fun. They were happy.

One day, the family saw some smoke. The smoke came from a big fire. The fire was near their house. They were scared. They wanted to settle somewhere safe.

The family left their regular house. They went far away to find a new home. They found a new place to settle. There was no smoke or fire there. They built a new house. Now, they were safe and happy again.

Once upon a time there was a very thoughtful girl. She would often invite her friends to her house to play. On this particular day, her best friend had come over and they were exploring the backyard.

"Look, what's that?" asked the friend, pointing to something.

The girl looked carefully and saw it was a toy car. It was old and rusty but she knew it could be fixed.

"I think this car needs a new battery," she said.

They found an old battery and worked together to get the car running again. The girl turned to her friend.

"Let's try and reverse it," she said.

Excitedly, they got the car going in reverse. Whooping and cheering, their excitement filled the backyard. Even their parents came out to see what all the noise was about.

The girl smiled, knowing she had been thoughtful and been able to fix the car.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went outside to pick some fruit from the trees. She saw a big, juicy apple and a small, sweet orange. She wanted to eat them both, but she couldn't carry them all by herself.

Suddenly, she saw her friend Billy walking by. She asked him if he wanted to join her and share the fruit. Billy was scared of climbing the tree, but Lily helped him up. Together, they picked the fruit and sat down to eat it. They were happy they could share and be friends.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play in the park. They have a ball and a bike. They take turns to kick the ball and ride the bike.

One day, a big boy comes to the park. He has a big bike and a big ball. He says to Tim and Sam, "You have small toys. You are babies. Give me your toys. I will add them to mine."

Tim and Sam are scared. They do not want to give their toys. They say, "No, these are our toys. You are mean. Go away."

The big boy gets angry. He tries to grab the ball and the bike. Tim and Sam run away. They hide behind a tree.

The big boy chases them. He is foolish. He does not see a hole in the ground. He falls into the hole. He drops his ball and his bike. He cries.

Tim and Sam come out of the tree. They see the big boy in the hole. They feel sorry for him. They say, "Are you okay? Do you need help?"

The big boy says, "Yes, please. I am sorry. I was mean. Can we be friends?"

Tim and Sam nod. They help the big boy out of the hole. They share their toys. They play together in the park. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pale dress and loved to play outside. One day, she found a big number three on the ground. She picked it up and showed it to her mommy. "Look mommy, I found a number!" she said with a big smile. Her mommy was proud of her and gave her a hug. Lily loved when her mommy hugged her. 

Later that day, Lily went to the park to play. She saw a little boy who was sad. She went over to him and said, "Hi, my name is Lily. Do you want to play with me?" The little boy smiled and said, "Yes, please." Lily and the little boy played together and had so much fun. They loved playing together so much that they became best friends. 

From that day on, Lily and her new friend played together every day. They loved each other's company and never wanted to be apart. Lily was so happy that she found the number three and made a new friend. She knew that it was a special day that she would always remember.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to jog in the park with her mommy. One day, while they were jogging, they saw a spark on the ground. 

"Mommy, what is that spark?" Lily asked.

"I'm not sure, let's go take a closer look," her mommy replied.

As they got closer, they saw a confused little bird sitting next to the spark. 

"Are you okay, little bird?" Lily asked.

The bird looked up at them and chirped, "I'm lost and I don't know how to get home."

"Don't worry, we'll help you find your way," Lily said with a smile. 

So, they picked up the little bird and jogged around the park until they found its home. The bird's family was so happy to see it and thanked Lily and her mommy for their help. From that day on, Lily and her mommy always kept an eye out for any lost animals while they jogged in the park.

Karen had been so excited for the day. She was ready to be independent and do something on her own. At last, the time came for her to release her little pet, who had been waiting for their dinner.

Karen went outside with a bowl full of food. She walked over to a big box and opened it. Out popped her pet! She was a small, fluffy white rabbit.

Karen put the bowl down and watched the rabbit happily eating its dinner. She giggled as it nibbled away at the food. She liked being able to watch her pet so independent.

When the rabbit was done, Karen picked up the bowl and put it away. Then, she hugged the bunny and released it back into the box. She felt so proud of herself for taking care of her pet and being able to take it out to eat.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny named Benny. Benny lived in a cage with his bunny friends. One day, Benny saw a pretty butterfly outside of his cage. He wanted to kiss the butterfly, but he couldn't because he was stuck in his cage.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who lived in a beautiful palace. She had a pet cat named Mittens who loved to play with her. One day, the princess wanted to play hide and seek with Mittens. She told Mittens to lie down and close his eyes while she hid.

Teddy was a little bear who loved to play the piano. He loved to hear it's orange keys and make funny sounds.

One day, Teddy wanted to have a special day of playing. He wanted to show off to all his friends all of the things he could do. He ran to the piano and squeezed the keys. He felt so proud, so excited!

Lily and Tom were playing in the living room. They saw a big cushion on the sofa. They wanted to have fun with it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a favorite toy car that he loved to play with every day. One day, Timmy's mom told him to clean up his toys before dinner. Timmy was in a rush to finish cleaning so he could play with his toy car again.

Lily and Tom are playing in the kitchen. They see a big jar of salt on the table. Lily wants to taste it. She takes a pinch and puts it in her mouth.

"Yuck!" she says. "This is not sugar. This is salt. It is very bad."

Tom laughs. He thinks it is funny. He takes a pinch and puts it in his mouth too.

"Hello, kids," their mom says. "What are you doing in the kitchen?"

Their mom sees the salt on their lips. She sees the jar of salt behind the chair. She is not happy.

"Did you touch the salt?" she asks.

Lily and Tom do not answer. They look at the floor. They know they did something wrong.

Their mom picks up the jar of salt. She sees a green sticker on it. She reads the sticker. It says: "Do not eat. This is not salt. This is fertilizer for the plants."

"Oh, no!" she says. "This is not salt. This is fertilizer. It is very bad for you. It can make you sick."

She takes Lily and Tom to the bathroom. She makes them rinse their mouths with water. She calls the doctor. She asks if they are okay.

The doctor says they are okay. He says they should not eat fertilizer again. He says they should only eat food.

Lily and Tom say they are sorry. They say they will not eat fertilizer again. They say they will only eat food.

Their mom hugs them. She says she loves them. She says they should be careful. She says they should always answer her questions.

Lily and Tom nod. They say they love her too. They say they will be careful. They say they will always answer her questions.

Once upon a time, there was a brave boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside on the lawn. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a new jacket with a zipper. Timmy was so excited to zip and unzip his jacket.

One day, Paul was walking in a place he had never been before. He saw a mother, pushing a baby in a stroller and he ran up to her. She had an understanding smile. Paul asked her what it was like for the baby.

Once upon a time there were two best friends called Sarah and Zoe. Zoe was invited to Sarah's bedroom for a special treat. Zoe was very excited to go.

Max was excited. He was going to go outside and see the unusual sky. He looked up and saw the dark clouds and wondered what form the clouds would take. He began to run towards them, but was stopped by his mom.

"Mama and Baby were walking in the park. It was a quiet day as the birds were singing in the trees. Mama and Baby walked by a small pond and Mama saw a frog. "Look, Baby!" Mama said with excitement.

Once upon a time, there was a duck. He was a very important duck, as he spread joy and cheer everywhere he went. One day while walking on the farm he saw a strange little creature. "Hello, what are you?" said the duck.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who had a stuffed owl that she loved to play with. One day, Lily's mommy asked her if she wanted to go for a walk in the park. Lily was very excited and said, "Yes, mommy! Can I bring my owl with me?"

Mommy smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. Your owl is very healthy and loves to go on walks with us." So, Lily grabbed her owl and they all went to the park.

As they walked, Lily saw a real owl sleeping on a branch. She pointed and said, "Look mommy, an owl! It's sleeping." Mommy said, "Yes, owls sleep during the day and are awake at night."

Lily was happy to see the owl and her stuffed owl was happy too. They all had a fun day in the park together.

One day, Timmy was out in his backyard and decided it would be fun to explore. He started digging in the dirt and all of a sudden, he discovered something unexpected! It was a purple sauce! He smiled because the sauce was a surprise, and it was his favorite color.

Timmy's mom came over and asked him what he had found.

Timmy said excitedly, "I found some purple sauce!"

His mom laughed and said, "That's great! Let's have a picnic and add the purple sauce to our sandwiches!"

So, Timmy and his mom had a picnic and added the purple sauce to their sandwiches, and it was delicious. They had a fun time and Timmy enjoyed his special discovery.

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play with blocks and dolls. They also like to learn new things. Anna's mom is a teach. She helps them to number the blocks. One, two, three, four, five. Tom and Anna can count to five.

One day, Anna brings a new toy to play. It is an enormous truck. It has big wheels and a loud horn. Tom likes the truck. He wants to play with it. He asks Anna, "Can I have the truck?"

Anna says, "No, it is mine. You have your own toys. Go play with them." She hugs the truck and does not share.

Tom is sad and angry. He thinks Anna is mean. He says, "You are not my friend. You are selfish. I don't want to play with you." He takes his blocks and dolls and goes to another corner.

Anna is also sad and angry. She thinks Tom is rude. She says, "You are not my friend. You are greedy. I don't need you." She plays with the truck by herself.

They do not talk to each other for a long time. They miss each other, but they are too proud to say sorry.

Anna's mom sees them. She knows they are unhappy. She goes to them and says, "Why are you not playing together? You are friends. Friends share and care. Friends say sorry and forgive. Friends have fun together."

Tom and Anna look at each other. They feel sorry for what they said and did. They say, "We are sorry. We were wrong. We want to be friends again. Can we share the truck and play together?"

Anna's mom smiles and says, "Of course you can. That is very nice of you. Sharing is good. It makes you and others happy. It is also fun to learn new things together. Do you want me to teach you how to number the wheels of the truck?"

Tom and Anna nod and say, "Yes, please. We want to learn. We want to play. We want to be friends."

They hug each other and go to play with the truck. They number the wheels. Six, seven, eight, nine, ten. They can count to ten. They are happy. They are friends. They learned a lesson.

Timmy was a happy, healthy boy. He loved to play outside and explore. Every day he would laugh and watch the clouds in the sky.

One day his mum took him to the park. There were lots of kids playing on the swings and the slide. Timmy ran around with them and laughed when it was his turn to go down the slide.

When it was time to go home, Timmy's mum took him to the park again. This time, Timmy laughed even louder as he ran around and played with the other kids. He also watched them play on the swings and giggled when he saw them go up and down. 

When it was time to go home again, Timmy was so excited. He was so happy and healthy he couldn't stop laughing and smiling. He knew that going to the park was always lots of fun and he couldn't wait to go back again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a kind little boy named Timmy. He loved playing with his toys, but one day he accidentally broke the leg of his favorite teddy bear. Timmy was sad and didn't know what to do. 

His mom saw him crying and asked him what happened. Timmy explained that he broke his teddy bear's leg. His mom said, "Don't worry, Timmy. We can remove the broken leg and fix it." 

Timmy was happy to hear that and watched as his mom carefully removed the broken leg. She then fixed it and put it back on the teddy bear. Timmy was so happy that his favorite toy was fixed and could play with him again. 

He hugged his mom and said, "Thank you for being so kind and fixing my teddy bear's leg." His mom smiled and said, "I will always help you when you need it." And from that day on, Timmy knew that his mom was always there to help him.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy. She was always busy, running around and doing things. But one day, she had a bright idea. She decided she needed an apron. So she kept looking and looking until she found one she liked. 

But it was quite hard to get it. She asked lots of people, and they all said no. But she was very persistent. She would not give up! 

Then one day, a friend told her. She knew someone who could deliver the apron right to her door. So the mommy was very happy. 

Finally, the apron arrived. It was perfect! Much better than the mommy ever dreamed. 

The mommy was so pleased. She never gave up and it was worth it. She was now able to do even more work, and look great while doing it. She never forgot how persistent she was!

Once upon a time, there was a little gray cat. The cat liked to sleep all day and all night. One day, the cat's owner woke him up and said, "I have a prize for you!" The cat was very excited and followed his owner to the kitchen.

In the kitchen, the owner showed the cat a big bowl of milk. The cat was so happy and drank all the milk. After drinking the milk, the cat went back to sleep. He dreamed about the prize he got and how delicious the milk was.

The next day, the cat woke up and saw that the prize was gone. He looked around the house and found a little toy mouse. The cat was very happy and played with the toy mouse all day long. From that day on, the little gray cat was always excited when his owner woke him up, hoping for another prize.

Once upon a time there were two friends. They were Jack and Jill. Jack liked to play games. But Jill liked to jump and run.

One day, Jack wanted to play a game. He held up a switch and asked Jill to play. Jill looked at the switch and said no. She refused to play with the switch.

Jack got mad and started to yell. He said it was a brilliant game. But Jill still said no. She wouldn't even look at the switch.

Jack was very sad. He couldn't understand why Jill didn't want to play with him. Then he smiled and said she could just jump and run. And Jill smiled too. She was happy to play with Jack. They had lots of fun.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide and swing. They saw a big oak tree with many leaves and acorns. They decided to climb the tree and see how high they could go.

"Look, Lily, I can reach this branch!" Tom said, pulling himself up.

"Wow, Tom, you are very brave!" Lily said, following him. "Can you see the birds and the sky?"

"Yes, Lily, I can see them. They are very pretty!" Tom said, looking around.

They climbed higher and higher, until they reached the top of the tree. They felt the wind in their hair and the sun on their faces. They smiled and laughed and hugged each other.

"Tom, Lily, it's time to go home!" their mom called from below. "Come down, please!"

"OK, mom, we are coming!" Tom and Lily said. They decided to climb down the tree carefully and slowly. They did not want to fall or hurt themselves.

They reached the ground and ran to their mom. They were very tired from climbing the tree, but also very happy. They hugged their mom and thanked her for taking them to the park.

"Did you have fun, Tom and Lily?" their mom asked.

"Yes, mom, we had a lot of fun!" Tom and Lily said. "We climbed the big oak tree and saw the birds and the sky!"

"That's wonderful, my loves!" their mom said. "Now let's go home and have some snacks and rest. You must be hungry and sleepy!"

Tom and Lily nodded and held their mom's hand. They walked home, talking about their adventure in the park. They decided they liked the big oak tree very much. They hoped to climb it again soon.

Once upon a time there was a hero who was brave and strong. She was always ready to help those who were in need.

One day the hero was walking through the town when she heard a loud yelling. She looked around and saw a little boy, pushing against a wall but he couldnâ€™t move it. 

The hero rushed to help him, but she was surprised when the boy thanked her before she had even done anything. The hero then leaned against the wall and it quickly moved away. The boy was so happy!
